英文正文: Lyn the Librarian asked me to recover 25 Torn Ledger Pages the fairies took, then have Chief Stan in Henesys stamp the cover. I can probably find fairies in Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North VI, Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North VII, or Someone Else's House.
中文正文: 图书管理员琳让我找回妖精拿走的25页破损账簿，再请射手村的斯坦长老在封面上盖章。\n\n我大概能在树洞迷宫：北部森林 VI、树洞迷宫：北部森林 VII，或别人的家找到妖精。

英文正文: Lyn the Librarian asked me to recover 50 Torn Ledger Pages the fairies took, then have Chief Stan in Henesys stamp the cover. I can probably find fairies in Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North VI, Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North VII, or Someone Else's House.
中文正文: 图书管理员琳让我找回妖精拿走的50页破损账簿，再请射手村的斯坦长老在封面上盖章。

# 英文标题: Silas Irons in Need of Help
中文阶段标题: 西拉斯·艾恩斯需要帮助
英文正文: Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, received an important request, but he's been struggling because he's short on materials. I need to defeat Bubblings and bring back Mithril Ingot to help him out.
中文正文: 勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯接到了一项重要委托，却因缺少材料而犯愁。我需要打倒蓝水灵，并带回秘银锭来帮助他。

英文正文: I met an old, balding man named Mr. Wetbottom in the VIP Sauna in Sleepywood. His son's run away from home with a book that's apparently more important to him than his own son?? He asked that I find his son, get the book, and bring JUST the book back. He offered me a nice sauna robe as a reward. Mr. Wetbottom told me that his son, Ronnie, likes to hang out at a tree tunnel somewhere around Ellinia. That's probably a good place to start searching. Seriously, though, just what is in that book of his...???
中文正文: 我在林中之城的高级桑拿房遇到了一位名叫泰素夫的秃头老人。他儿子带着一本书离家出走了，而那本书似乎比他亲儿子还重要？他让我找到儿子，拿到书，而且只把书带回来。他答应送我一件漂亮的桑拿服作为报酬。\n\n泰素夫说，他的儿子罗尼喜欢在魔法密林附近某个树洞里玩耍。那里应该是开始寻找的好地方。不过说真的，那本书里到底有什么……？
别名（|分隔）: A Clue to the Secret Book

# 英文标题: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash
英文正文: I ran into Shumi again in Kerning City. She was really stressed out because she lost her rent money when a Stirge flew over and snatched it from her. Man... Do I have to go back down to the subway again...? Can I just pay her rent for her at this point? Anyway, I need to go back in there, this time to Construction Site B2, and find the roll
中文正文: 我又在废弃都市遇到了休咪。一只蝙蝠怪飞过来抢走了她的房租钱，她为此十分焦虑。唉……我还得再下去地铁一趟吗？现在能不能干脆替她付房租？总之，我需要再次进去，这次前往工地B2，寻找她丢失的那卷现金……

# 英文标题: Make a Octopus & Mushroom Omok Set
中文阶段标题: 制作三眼章鱼/蘑菇五子棋
英文正文: I brought the requested items to Casey in Henesys Park and received a Octopus & Mushroom Omok Set! With this, I can play the Omok mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask Casey if I want to know more about the mini-game.
中文正文: 我把所需物品交给了射手村公园的凯茜，并获得了一副三眼章鱼/蘑菇五子棋！有了它，我可以随时随地和其他冒险家玩五子棋小游戏！如果想进一步了解小游戏，记得去问凯茜。

英文正文: Heena asked me to get a mirror from her sister, so I walked all the way to Sera.
中文正文: 赫娜让我去她姐姐那里拿镜子，我一路走到了塞拉那儿。

英文正文: I successfully passed Olaf's training. But is this really enough?
中文正文: 我顺利通过了奥拉夫的第一次训练。不过，这样真的够了吗？

英文正文: After reaching Level 10, I was able to get information about the job advancement from Phil. It seems you can advance to a Warrior in Perion, a Magician in Ellinia, an Archer in Henesys, and a Thief in Kerning City. Talking to Phil will allow you to go straight to your town of choice. Since a job advancement cannot be undone once made, I'd better choose carefully...
中文正文: 升到 10 级后，我从菲尔那里得知了转职的信息。似乎可以在勇士部落转职为战士、在魔法密林转职为魔法师、在射手村转职为弓箭手、在废弃都市转职为飞侠。和菲尔交谈就能直接前往想去的城镇。转职一旦完成就无法反悔，我还是慎重选择为好……

英文正文: I delivered the Blue Mushroom Caps and Horny Mushroom Caps to Jane. I wonder if this will really change her father's mind... She's wearing bunny ears, for goodness' sake! Ah well, it's none of my business. In return, Jane gave me a scroll for ATT. My weapon's going to be awesome... if the scroll works.
中文正文: 我把蓝蘑菇盖和刺蘑菇盖交给了简。不知道这真的能改变她父亲的想法吗……她可是戴着兔耳朵啊！唉，反正不关我的事。作为回报，简给了我一张攻击卷轴。只要卷轴成功，我的武器就会变得很厉害……

英文正文: I got the materials Jane needed to make some Elixirs. If she fails... is the whole place going to blow up?
中文正文: 我拿到了简制作万能药所需的材料。要是她失败了……这地方会不会整个炸掉？

英文正文: I got Jane the materials she needed. If she does well, I'll get some nice elixirs. If not... er, I wonder if I HAVE to take what she makes me...
中文正文: 我把简需要的材料交给了她。如果她做得好，我就能拿到不错的万能药；要是做不好……呃，我非得收下她做的东西吗……

英文正文: I got the materials Jane needed and the scroll for gloves was made without a hitch. Sweet! Jane expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting. Maybe next time I return I'll be able to buy something from her that's not sold in stores...
中文正文: 我拿到了简需要的材料，手套卷轴也顺利做好了。太棒了！简表示还想继续实验。也许下次再来时，我就能从她那里买到商店里没有的东西了……

# 英文标题: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Pink Flower Basket
英文正文: I got John all 10 Pink Violas. With these, he can make a beautiful flower basket for his wife on their anniversary. As a sign of appreciation, John got me a whole bunch of screws that were left over from parts of a ship. By the way, if there are this many screws that had fallen out of that ship, then how in the world is it even still sailing...? Is it still carrying passengers???
中文正文: 我帮约翰采齐了 10 朵粉红紫罗兰。有了这些，他就能在结婚纪念日给妻子做一个漂亮的花篮。作为谢礼，约翰给了我一堆从船体零件上掉下来的螺丝。话说回来，一艘船掉了这么多螺丝，它到底是怎么还能航行的……上面还载着乘客吗？？？

英文正文: I got John all 20 Blue Violas. They do have a nice scent, but 20 of them? Makes my head spin... As a sign of appreciation, John gave me a nice glove he found inside the ship. I mean, it looks like someone accidentally left their glove there... Is he allowed to give it to me like that? What if I wear it around town and run into its actual owner??
中文正文: 我帮约翰采齐了 20 朵蓝紫罗兰。花香确实好闻，可 20 朵？闻得我头都晕了……作为谢礼，约翰送了我一只在船里捡到的手套。那看起来像是有人不小心落下的……他真的可以就这样送给我吗？要是我戴着它在镇上走，正好碰上真正的主人怎么办？？

# 英文标题: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Last Present
英文正文: I got John all 30 White Violas. They have a nice scent, but 30 of them? Makes my head spin... As a sign of appreciation, John gave me a set of his mother's earrings. These earrings look like they are made of some common flowers, but it seems there's something more to them...
中文正文: 我帮约翰采齐了 30 朵白紫罗兰。花香确实好闻，可 30 朵？闻得我头都晕了……作为谢礼，约翰送了我一套他母亲的耳环。这些耳环看起来像是用普通花朵做的，但似乎另有玄机……

英文正文: I passed Olaf's second training with flying colors! Once I reach Level 10, I'll be all set to choose my job!
中文正文: 我以优异的成绩通过了奥拉夫的第二次训练！等我升到 10 级，就可以正式选择职业了！

英文正文: I got the mirror from Sera, who was doing her laundry, and took it to Heena.
中文正文: 我从正在洗衣服的塞拉那里拿到了镜子，并把它交给了赫娜。

英文正文: I delivered 1 Slime Bubble to Teo in Lith Harbor. But from the look on his face, he's already craving something else...
中文正文: 我把 1 个绿水灵泡泡交给了明珠港的泰奥。可看他的表情，他似乎又馋上别的东西了……

英文正文: I delivered a Pig's Head to Teo in Lith Harbor. I guess I should keep his weird hobby a secret between us.
中文正文: 我把一个猪头交给了明珠港的泰奥。我想，他的怪癖还是我们俩知道就好。

英文正文: You learned how to use items! This will make life much easier!
中文正文: 你学会了如何使用道具！这会让生活轻松不少！

英文正文: You asked Sen, Nina's brother, what he wants for dinner. He said he wants Mushroom Soup.
中文正文: 你问了妮娜的弟弟森想吃什么。他说他想喝蘑菇汤。

英文正文: You told Nina what Sen wants for dinner.
中文正文: 你把森想吃的晚餐告诉了妮娜。

英文正文: You defeated the monsters, just as Todd instructed.
中文正文: 你按照托德的指导击败了怪物。

英文正文: As Sam suggested, you hunted 10 Snails, then met Mai. Is this person a master? They definitely give off a strong, powerful vibe.
中文正文: 按照萨姆的建议，你击败了 10 只蜗牛，然后见到了麦。这个人是个高手吗？他身上确实散发着强大而厉害的气场。

英文正文: I delivered Maria's Letter to Lucas in Amherst.
中文正文: 我把玛丽亚的信交给了阿默斯特的卢卡斯。

英文正文: Maria looked relieved after reading the reply from Lucas. Now I want to read it too. Wonder what this was all about...
中文正文: 读完卢卡斯的回信后，玛丽亚看起来松了口气。现在我也想看看信里写了什么。不知道这到底是怎么回事……

英文正文: Mai trained you, and you feel stronger.
中文正文: 麦训练了你，你感觉自己变强了。

英文正文: After Mai's training, I feel much, much stronger. Time to get off Maple Island! I should go to Southperry and take the boat to Victoria Island.
中文正文: 经过麦的训练，我感觉自己强大了许多。该离开冒险岛了！我该去南港坐船前往维多利亚岛。

中文阶段标题: 明明女士的第一个担心
英文正文: I brought back all the stuff Mrs. Ming Ming asked me for, but I'm sure these decorations are not the only things needed for the festival...
中文正文: 我把明明夫人要的东西全都带回来了，但我敢肯定，节日需要的装饰品绝对不止这些……

中文阶段标题: 明明女士的第二个担心
英文正文: I met up with Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia to get her Estelle's Special Sauce, but she apparently doesn't want to give it to me for free...
中文正文: 我在魔法密林南边的田野见到了艾丝黛尔，想拿到她的特制酱汁，可她似乎并不打算白送给我……

英文正文: I got 1 Garnet for Estelle, who I met near The Field South of Ellinia, for making her mother's birthday present. She gave me Estelle's Special Sauce. I better collect the other materials and return to Mrs. Ming Ming.
中文正文: 我在魔法密林南边的田野附近见到了艾丝黛尔，为了给她母亲准备生日礼物，我帮她拿到了 1 颗石榴石。她把特制酱汁给了我。我最好再收集齐其他材料，然后回去找明明夫人。

英文正文: I got all the materials that Mrs. Ming Ming asked me to get and gave them to her. I can't wait to see the village carnival!
中文正文: 我把明明夫人要我找的材料全都收集齐并交给了她。真期待看到村里的狂欢节！

英文正文: I delivered 20 Green Mushroom Caps and 20 Blue Mushroom Caps to Pia in Henesys Park. She was thrilled that she got vengeance on the mushrooms and gave me a scroll for hat. All I have to do is click on it in the Use tab of my Item Inventory and drag it to my helmet in the Equipment window... Oh, and I'll have to cross my fingers and hope the scroll doesn't fail.
中文正文: 我把 20 个绿蘑菇盖和 20 个蓝蘑菇盖交给了射手村公园的皮娅。她因为向蘑菇们报了仇而兴奋不已，还给了我一张头盔卷轴。我只要在道具栏的“使用”页里点它，再拖到装备窗口里的头盔上就行了……哦，还得祈祷卷轴别失败。

英文正文: I delivered a gift from Camila to Utah. I'm sure they're really close friends, since they're giving each other what's most precious to themselves. I wish I could meet a friend like that during my journey...
中文正文: 我把卡米拉送给乌塔的礼物交给了他。他们一定是非常要好的朋友，因为彼此都把最珍贵的东西送给对方。真希望在这趟旅途中，我也能遇到这样的朋友……

英文正文: Maya wanted me to go see Teo of Lith Harbor, so I did just that. He promised to give me the Weird Medicine, but only after I get him a Sparkling Rock. Geez, he won't even give any free medicine for a sick girl?
中文正文: 射手村的玛雅让我去明珠港找泰奥，我照做了。他答应给我怪药，但条件是我得先给他一块闪亮的石头。真是的，连给生病的小姑娘一点药都不肯白给吗？

英文正文: I met Sophia. To make the Sparkling Rock, she said she needs Arcon's Blood.
中文正文: 我见到了索菲亚。她说要制作闪亮的石头，需要阿尔康之血。

英文正文: Sophia told me that Manji has some Arcon's Blood, a key ingredient in making a Sparkling Rock.
中文正文: 索菲亚告诉我，曼吉那里有阿尔康之血，那是制作闪亮石头的关键材料。

英文正文: Manji asked me to defeat Zombie Mushrooms and gather Charm of the Undead in return for Arcon's Blood.
中文正文: 曼吉让我击败僵尸蘑菇、收集亡灵护符，以此交换阿尔康之血。

英文正文: I gathered 1 Orange Mushroom Cap and 10 Blue Snail Shells for Biggs in Southperry. The weapon he gave me as a reward was pretty decent.
中文正文: 我帮南港的比格斯收集了 1 个橙蘑菇盖和 10 个蓝蜗牛壳。他作为报酬给我的武器还挺不错的。

英文正文: I brought the Charm of the Undead to Manji and finally got Arcon's Blood. I should hurry back to Sophia...
中文正文: 我把亡灵护符交给了曼吉，终于拿到了阿尔康之血。我得赶紧回去找索菲亚……

英文正文: Sophia was startled when she saw I had gotten Arcon's Blood, and she made me a Sparkling Rock with it. Now then, should I go back to Teo in Lith Harbor?
中文正文: 索菲亚看到我拿到阿尔康之血时吃了一惊，并用它为我做出了一块闪亮的石头。那么，现在该回明珠港找泰奥了吧？

英文正文: I went back to Henesys and handed Maya the Weird Medicine. Hopefully it'll help her get better. As a sign of thanks, Maya gave me some Mesos and a Brown Bamboo Hat. The hat... I mean, it looked like it'd protect me from the sun, but it was so old and raggedy... And when I put it on, it made this weird noise... It felt like insects were moving around inside it... Am I going to be okay?
中文正文: 我回到射手村，把怪药交给了玛雅。希望这能让她好起来。作为答谢，玛雅给了我一些金币和一顶棕色竹帽。那顶帽子……看起来倒是能遮阳，可它又旧又破……戴上时还发出怪声……感觉里面有虫子在爬……我会没事吧？

中文阶段标题: 迷宫入口的守卫兵，鲁克
英文正文: I got Luke, who protects the entrance of the dungeon, the stuff he asked for. Since he was already making the Snake Drink and all... I wanted a taste for myself! In return, Luke gave me a nicely refined jewel he found around the area. It's not like refined jewels fall from the sky... Did someone lose it while traveling? Anyway, I should drop by later when the Snake Drink is ready...
中文正文: 我把守在地牢入口的卢克要的东西交给了他。既然他本来就在做蛇酒……我也想尝一口！作为回报，卢克送了我一颗在附近捡到的、打磨得很精致的宝石。打磨好的宝石可不会从天上掉下来……是有人在旅途中弄丢的吗？总之，等蛇酒做好了我再过来看看……

# 英文标题: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel
英文正文: I brought Luke the materials he needed to make the gloves and received his treasured heirloom helmet, Bronze Crusader Helm, in return. It felt like I got the short end of the deal... but since it's a family heirloom, passed down for generations, I couldn't really complain...
中文正文: 我把卢克制作手套所需的材料带来了，作为回报，我拿到了他家传的宝贝头盔“青铜十字军头盔”。总觉得自己吃了亏……可那毕竟是代代相传的家传之宝，我也实在不好抱怨……

英文正文: I got everything Maya asked for, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??
中文正文: 我把玛雅要的东西全都收集齐了，可什么时候才给我报酬呢？什么？还要再来多少次啊？？

英文正文: I got everything Maya asked for. Please don't tell me she wanted all of it for free...
中文正文: 我把玛雅要的东西全都收集齐了。可别告诉我她全都想白拿……

英文正文: I got everything Maya asked for. I'm still not getting anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??
中文正文: 我把玛雅要的东西全都收集齐了。还是什么都没给我？？我还得再来多少次啊？？

英文正文: I got all the items Maya requested for the last time... or is it? As a sign of appreciation, she gave me a cape her grandma made for Athena Pierce, the chief of this town. It may be really old, but it still looks brand new!
中文正文: 我最后一次帮玛雅收集齐了所有物品……真的是最后一次吗？作为答谢，她给了我一件她奶奶为本镇村长雅典娜·皮尔斯做的披风。那披风虽然很旧了，看起来却像全新的一样！

英文正文: Pia asked me help her with a gift for her friend who decided to set out on an adventure. I brought back what she needed, but it seemed that wasn't enough.
中文正文: 皮娅请我帮她给一位决定踏上冒险之旅的朋友准备礼物。我把她需要的东西带回来了，但似乎还不太够。

英文正文: I broke wooden boxes and collected supplies for Pio. It was fun because I found other useful items in the boxes as well.
中文正文: 我打碎木箱，帮皮奥收集了物资。挺有趣的，因为我还从箱子里找到了其他有用的东西。

英文正文: I went to Rina to get Pia's cape, but Rina told me that she's keeping the cape until Pia brings back what she borrowed from her.
中文正文: 我去莉娜那里帮皮娅拿披风，可莉娜说，要等皮娅把她借走的东西还回来，她才肯交出披风。

英文正文: I paid off Pia's debt to Rina on her behalf and received the Red Cape in return. Next, all I have to do is bring this back to Pia.
中文正文: 我替皮娅还清了她欠莉娜的债，换回了红色披风。接下来只要把它带回去给皮娅就行了。

英文正文: I delivered the materials needed to make the claw to Pia in Henesys Park and received a scroll in return. I wonder if Pia's friend has already set out on their adventure by now. Who knows? Maybe I'll run into them during my travels!
中文正文: 我把制作拳套所需的材料交给了射手村公园的皮娅，换回一张卷轴。不知道皮娅的那位朋友是不是已经踏上冒险之旅了。谁知道呢？也许我在旅途中会遇上他们！

# 英文标题: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
英文正文: I helped Bruce gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter?
中文正文: 我帮布鲁斯收集了他研究所需的材料。这些能帮他找到女儿吗？

# 英文标题: I Need to Find My Daughter 1
英文正文: I found Ayan and gave her Ayan's Toy Sword.
中文正文: 我找到了阿扬，并把阿扬的玩具剑交给了她。

# 英文标题: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
英文正文: I was so glad that Ayan got her memory back. I was even gladder that Bruce finally got to see his daughter again! How touching...
中文正文: 阿扬恢复了记忆，我真是太高兴了。更高兴的是，布鲁斯终于又见到了女儿！真让人感动……

英文正文: Jay said that the author of The Snail Legend was his great-grandfather, Alloy, who was also Mrs. Ming Ming’s grandfather.
中文正文: 杰伊说，《蜗牛传说》的作者就是他的曾祖父阿洛伊，而他也是明明夫人的祖父。

英文正文: Wing the Fairy recalls Alloy as the human who obtained Mano’s shell to extend his own lifespan. Let’s ask a few more questions.
中文正文: 妖精温回忆起阿洛伊，说他是为了延长自己的寿命而取得马诺龟壳的人类。再多问几个问题吧。

英文正文: Gave snail shells to Wing the Fairy and in return got information that Mano frequently appeared near the thicket around the beach.
中文正文: 我把蜗牛壳交给了妖精温，作为回报，得到了马诺经常出现在海滩附近灌木丛的情报。

英文正文: Pia in Henesys seems all fired up.
中文正文: 射手村的皮娅看起来干劲十足。

英文正文: Rain's first question was about how to hang from a ladder or rope. All right! Up arrow key, make sure to remember it well.
中文正文: 雷恩的第一个问题是关于如何攀爬梯子或绳索。好！按上方向键，一定要记牢。

# 英文标题: A rainbow snail shell that makes wishes come true!?
中文阶段标题: 能实现愿望的彩虹蜗牛壳！？
英文正文: The Rainbow-colored Snail Shell wasn’t an item that makes dreams come true. It turns people who use it into snails. Phew… learned a good lesson not to believe in rumors, otherwise I would be the one crawling about.
中文正文: 彩虹色蜗牛壳并不是能让人愿望成真的道具，而是会把使用者变成蜗牛的东西。呼……学到了一个好教训，不能轻信传言，否则现在爬来爬去的就是我了。

英文正文: Rain's question was about equippable items, which can be worn by double-clicking on them.
中文正文: 雷恩的问题是关于可装备道具的，只要双击就能穿戴。

英文正文: In the Equipment Inventory, I can check the items I'm wearing, and I can also double-click to unequip them.
中文正文: 在装备栏里可以查看身上穿戴的道具，双击就能脱下。

英文正文: Rain's fourth question was about ways to recover HP. I didn't know there were so many different methods! When I find a chair or bench, I should make sure to sit down.
中文正文: 雷恩的第四个问题是恢复 HP 的方法。我都不知道原来有这么多不同的办法！以后看到椅子或长椅，一定要坐一坐。

英文正文: Rain asked about job advancements. Warriors, Thieves, Bowmen, and Magicians all need to be at least level 10 to advance.
中文正文: 雷恩问的是转职。战士、飞侠、弓箭手和魔法师都至少要达到 10 级才能转职。

英文正文: I learned that when I level up, I get AP. If I use the AP on the stats I want, I can make them stronger. I'll make sure to remember that.
中文正文: 我了解到升级后会获得能力点。把能力点加到想要的能力值上，就能让它变得更强。我一定要记住这一点。

英文正文: Rain advised that it's time to leave Maple Island. In Victoria Island, I can choose a job and start a lot of new adventures. Head to Southperryto get to Victoria Island!
中文正文: 雷恩建议我该离开冒险岛了。到了维多利亚岛，就能选择职业、开始许多新的冒险。去南港就能前往维多利亚岛！

英文正文: I returned Arwen's Glass Shoe to Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia. I got lucky, finding it off a nasty Fire Boar. As a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's gorgeous and glimmers like a star. Maybe I can use this to make something special.
中文正文: 我把艾温的玻璃鞋还给了魔法密林的妖精艾温。运气真好，居然从一只凶恶的火野猪身上找到了它。作为答谢，她给了我一件妖精道具。那东西漂亮极了，像星星一样闪闪发光。也许我可以用它做点什么特别的东西。

英文正文: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 50 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 7 ores. I hope the forest returns to normal...
中文正文: 我在魔法密林附近的森林里消灭了一群僵尸猴，为罗文收集齐了 50 个被诅咒的娃娃。作为回报，她给了我 7 块矿石。希望森林能恢复原样……

英文正文: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in the forest near Ellinia and collected all 70 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 10 ores. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...
中文正文: 我在魔法密林附近的森林里消灭了一群僵尸猴，为罗文收集齐了 70 个被诅咒的娃娃。作为回报，她给了我 10 块矿石。希望森林能早日恢复原样……

英文正文: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 100 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 5 very rare ores. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...
中文正文: 我在魔法密林附近的森林里消灭了一群僵尸猴，为罗文收集齐了 100 个被诅咒的娃娃。作为回报，她给了我 5 块非常稀有的矿石。希望森林能早日恢复原样……

英文正文: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 150 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me a scroll for gloves. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...
中文正文: 我在魔法密林附近的森林里消灭了一群僵尸猴，为罗文收集齐了 150 个被诅咒的娃娃。作为回报，她给了我一张手套卷轴。希望森林能早日恢复原样……

英文正文: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 200 Cursed Dolls for Rowen the Fairy. In return, she gave me a nice hat. I collected so many dolls for her, but it seemed like the Zombie Lupins aren't decreasing in any way, shape, or form... I wonder what was going on. However, it seemed that the fairies might not have as much animosity toward humans now... That's a good thing, at least.
中文正文: 我在魔法密林附近的森林里消灭了一群僵尸猴，为妖精罗文收集齐了 200 个被诅咒的娃娃。作为回报，她给了我一顶不错的帽子。我为她收集了那么多娃娃，可僵尸猴看起来丝毫不见减少……不知道到底是怎么回事。不过，妖精们对人类的敌意似乎没有以前那么深了……至少这是件好事。

# 英文标题: First Material Delivery for Building a New House
英文正文: I got all the items Ronnie requested, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??
中文正文: 我把罗尼要的东西全都收集齐了，可什么时候才给我报酬呢？什么？还要再来多少次啊？？

# 英文标题: Second Material Delivery for Building a New House
英文正文: I got everything for Ronnie. Please don't tell me he wanted all these for free...!
中文正文: 我把罗尼要的东西全都收集齐了。可别告诉我他想全部白拿……！

# 英文标题: Third Material Delivery for Building a New House
英文正文: I got everything for Ronnie. I still didn't get anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??
中文正文: 我把罗尼要的东西全都收集齐了。还是什么都没给我？？我还得再来多少次啊？？

# 英文标题: Last Material Delivery for Building a New House
中文阶段标题: 为盖房子需要的最后材料
英文正文: I got all the materials Ronnie needed for the last time. Is this it? For the reward, he gave me a scroll for shoes he got as a gift from the fairies, who found it somewhere around the forest. He couldn't figure out how to use the scroll, so I'm getting it... hopefully it works... haha...
中文正文: 我最后一次帮罗尼收集齐了所有材料。就这些了吗？作为报酬，他给了我一张鞋子卷轴，那是妖精们从森林附近捡来送给他的。他搞不懂该怎么用，所以就转交给我了……希望它能成功……哈哈……

# 英文标题: I Need Help on My Homework!
英文正文: I helped Wing the Fairy of Ellinia with his homework. I have no idea what that potion is for, though.
中文正文: 我帮魔法密林的妖精温做了作业。不过我完全不知道那瓶药水是干什么用的。

英文正文: I gave Green Mushroom Caps to Shane in Ellinia. Can he really make a delicious meal out of this?
中文正文: 我把绿蘑菇盖交给了魔法密林的谢恩。他真的能用这个做出美味的料理吗？

# 英文标题: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More
英文正文: I delivered the Green Mushroom Caps and Lemon to Shane in Ellinia. It feels like the dish might actually taste better than the last one, doesn't it?
中文正文: 我把绿蘑菇盖和柠檬交给了魔法密林的谢恩。感觉这道菜说不定比上次的更好吃，对吧？

英文正文: As Alex requested, I looked for his father in Henesys to get Alex's mother's Old Gold Watch.
中文正文: 我按亚历克斯的请求，去射手村找他父亲，取回亚历克斯母亲的旧金表。

英文正文: Only after I brought the Green Mushroom Caps and Blue Mushroom Caps did Chief Stan start talking to me.
中文正文: 直到我带来绿蘑菇盖和蓝蘑菇盖，村长斯坦才肯跟我说话。

英文正文: I gave Alex his late mother's Old Gold Watch. As a sign of appreciation, he gave me an earring he received from friends he met while traveling. Well, Chief Stan forgave Alex, but it doesn't seem like Alex plans to head home right away. Maybe I should keep an eye open next time I'm in Henesys.
中文正文: 我把亚历克斯已故母亲的旧金表交给了他。作为答谢，他送了我一只在旅途中结识的朋友们送的耳环。村长斯坦虽然原谅了亚历克斯，但亚历克斯似乎并不打算马上回家。下次去射手村时，我得多留意一下。

英文正文: I delivered what Don Hwang asked for and got a bunch of Lemons in return. I wonder what kind of armor Don Hwang will make. Nella said there are many more requests I can fulfill. I should visit Nella every once in a while.
中文正文: 我把唐黄要的东西交给了他，换回一堆柠檬。不知道唐黄会打造出什么样的盔甲。内拉说还有很多委托可以接。我该时不时去找内拉看看。

英文正文: I delivered what Shumi asked for and got a bunch of Cakes in return. Now, Shumi's little puppy has his own house. Return to Nella for another gig.
中文正文: 我把休咪要的东西交给了她，换回一堆蛋糕。现在休咪的小狗也有自己的房子了。回内拉那里接下一个活儿吧。

英文正文: I delivered what Andre asked for and got a glove in return. I hope he enjoys his hearty bowl of Seafood Soup. Return to Nella for another gig.
中文正文: 我把安德烈要的东西交给了他，换回一只手套。希望他能好好享用那碗丰盛的海鲜汤。回内拉那里接下一个活儿吧。

英文正文: I delivered what Dr. Faymus asked for and got a bunch of White Potions in return. I wonder what kind of potion Dr. Faymus will make using those materials. Return to Nella for another gig.
中文正文: 我把费穆斯博士要的东西交给了他，换回一堆白色药水。不知道费穆斯博士会用这些材料做出什么样的药水。回内拉那里接下一个活儿吧。

英文正文: I delivered what Chris asked for and got some refined iron and bronze in return. Chris can finally sleep well with his new pillow. Return to Nella for another gig.
中文正文: 我把克里斯要的东西交给了他，换回一些精炼铁和精炼青铜。克里斯终于能枕着新枕头睡个好觉了。回内拉那里接下一个活儿吧。

英文正文: I delivered what Cutthroat Manny asked for and got a pair of shoes in return. Now... Cutthroat Manny doesn't have to worry about his dinner menu for a while. After helping out the people in this town, I feel like I've really become close with them!
中文正文: 我把凶徒曼尼要的东西交给了他，换回一双鞋子。这下……凶徒曼尼暂时不用为晚餐菜单发愁了。帮这个镇上的人做了这么多事，我感觉自己真的和他们亲近起来了！

英文正文: I actually collected Broken Mirror Glass for the stranger I met in the Niora Hospital and brought it back to her.
中文正文: 我为在尼奥拉医院遇到的那位陌生女子收集了破碎的镜片，并带回去交给了她。

英文正文: Jane Doe, whom I met in the Niora Hospital was a ghost. She was staying in the Hospital, not knowing that she was dead. She couldn't be revived with the Charm of the Undead. It seemed, deep down, that she already knew that, though... I really hope she finds peace.
中文正文: 我在尼奥拉医院遇到的简·多伊是个幽灵。她一直留在医院里，却不知道自己已经死了。亡灵护符无法让她复活。不过，她内心深处似乎早就知道了……真心希望她能安息。

英文正文: As requested by Lakelis, my friends and I challenged the party quest First Time Together and defeated King Slime. When everyone works together, there's nothing that can't be done!
中文正文: 应拉克里斯的请求，我和伙伴们挑战了组队任务“初次同行”，并击败了史莱姆王。只要大家齐心协力，就没有做不到的事！

英文正文: I found the lost coin that Shumi of Kerning City was looking for and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh...? As a reward, she gave me a bunch of return scrolls... Not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at Construction Site B1... I should check it out later...
中文正文: 我找到了废弃都市的休咪丢失的硬币，并还给了她。那是从朋友那里借来的宝贵硬币啊……？作为报酬，她给了我一大堆回城卷轴……真不错！！她还说在工地B1能捡到其他东西……我该找时间去看看……

# 英文标题: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash
英文正文: I found Shumi's lost Sack of Cash in the Kerning City subway. Shumi can now buy what JM From tha Streetz asked for. I received Mesos and some potions as a gift. I should go to Construction Site B3 in the subway to look for more stuff.
中文正文: 我在废弃都市的地铁里找到了休咪丢失的钱袋。休咪现在能买“街头混混JM”要的东西了。我收到了金币和药水作为谢礼。我该去地铁里的工地B3找找更多东西。

英文正文: I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.
中文正文: 我回答了废弃都市的伊卡路斯问的所有问题。挺简单的。

英文正文: I had fun playing around with Icarus.
中文正文: 我和伊卡路斯玩得很开心。

英文正文: I got the materials Icarus needed to make the hang glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge wings are enough to make the hang glider fly... I don't really know if this will work, but who knows, he could end up succeeding. I should check up on him when he's done building it.
中文正文: 我帮伊卡路斯收集了制作滑翔翼所需的材料，让他实现飞行的梦想。我只是在想，光靠蝙蝠翅膀，滑翔翼真的能飞起来吗……我不太确定这能不能行，但谁知道呢，说不定他真能成功。等他做好之后，我该去看看。

英文正文: I got the materials needed for Icarus to make a flying balloon and realize his dream of flying. I don't know if his 'flying balloon' will actually fly, but there's a chance that it might work. I'll check up on him around when the flying balloon should be ready to take flight and see if he's for real this time.
中文正文: 我帮伊卡路斯收集了制作热气球所需的材料，让他实现飞行的梦想。我不知道他的“热气球”是不是真能飞，但说不定能行。等热气球该能起飞的时候，我去看看他这次是不是来真的。

# 英文标题: In search of Wing the Fairy
英文正文: Wing the Fairy in Ellinia dislikes humans so much that he wouldn't even listen to what I had to say.
中文正文: 魔法密林的妖精温非常讨厌人类，连我说的话都不肯听。

# 英文标题: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine
英文正文: As Wing the Fairy asked, I got him the Medicine With Weird Vibes and Witchgrass Leaf items. Can he make the Flying Medicine with these?
中文正文: 按照妖精温的要求，我给他找来了“散发怪味的药”和“巫草叶”。他能用这些做出飞行药吗？

英文正文: I got Icarus the Flying Medicine that Wing the Fairy of Ellinia made. I hope it works for him.
中文正文: 我把魔法密林的妖精温做好的飞行药交给了伊卡路斯。希望这对他有用。

英文正文: I got Blackbull of Perion 10 #t4000005s and 10 Leafs after defeating 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward... and... well, there are scratch marks here and there, and it looks pretty old... Is this even usable?
中文正文: 我击败了 20 只古木妖和 20 只黑古木妖，为勇士部落的黑牛收集了 10 个#t4000005s和 10 片树叶。有了这些，他终于能修好房子了。作为报酬，我拿到了这面盾牌……呃……上面到处是划痕，看起来还挺旧的……这真的能用吗？

# 英文标题: Building a New House For Blackbull
英文正文: I got Blackbull the items he requested, so that all of his cousins could move to Perion. It was really tough, and I hope he doesn't ask me to BUILD a house for him next time...
中文正文: 我把黑牛要的东西交给了他，好让他的表兄弟们都能搬到勇士部落。真是够辛苦的，希望他下次别让我给他“盖”房子……

英文正文: I met Chrishrama in Sleepywood and was able to ask him how to awaken the Old Gladius.
中文正文: 我在林中之城见到了克里斯拉玛，向他请教了如何唤醒旧短剑。

英文正文: I gathered the materials needed for the awakening and took them to Chrishrama. Chrishrama used the materials to reawaken the Old Gladius into the Hero's Gladius. It's a nice sword that radiates a mysterious light... It's a shame I have to give it to Manji.
中文正文: 我收集齐了唤醒所需的材料，并带给了克里斯拉玛。克里斯拉玛用这些材料把旧短剑重新唤醒成了英雄短剑。那真是一把散发着神秘光芒的好剑……可惜我得把它交给曼吉。

英文正文: It seems that this Hero's Gladius, which Manji told me about, is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing between the Hero's Gladius and the Skull Earrings that Manji offered me, but I don't regret my choice.
中文正文: 曼吉说的这把英雄短剑，看起来确实是把好剑。我不得不在英雄短剑和曼吉开出的骷髅耳环之间做出艰难的选择，但我不后悔。

英文正文: I found the fossils that Winston lost.
中文正文: 我找到了温斯顿丢失的化石。

英文正文: Winston the archeologist in Perion said that it is not safe to leave the valuable fossils in his tent. He asked me to deliver them to Dr. Betty in Ellinia. Dr. Betty said she's going to be really busy from now, and she asked me to stop by again and give her a hand afterwards. Fossils, huh...? Should I give it a try?
中文正文: 勇士部落的考古学家温斯顿说，把珍贵的化石留在帐篷里不安全。他让我把化石送去魔法密林给贝蒂博士。贝蒂博士说她接下来会非常忙，让我之后再来帮她一把。化石啊……？要不要试试看？

英文正文: My first job as Dr. Betty's assistant was to collect some plants in the woods in Ellinia and sample them. It wasn't that hard, I guess.
中文正文: 作为贝蒂博士的助手，我的第一份工作是在魔法密林的树林里采集一些植物样本。感觉倒也不是很难。

英文正文: I met Dr. Betty's daughter, Anne, playing by herself near Henesys.
中文正文: 我在射手村附近见到了贝蒂博士的女儿安妮，她正一个人玩着。

英文正文: I collected some Plant Samples and a Stuffed Drake Skull to help Dr. Betty's research on fossils. I can't wait to see the results... I should go and see Dr. Betty, because she said she would tell me when I go back.
中文正文: 为了协助贝蒂博士研究化石，我收集了一些植物样本和一个飞龙骷髅标本。真期待研究结果……我该去找贝蒂博士，她说等我回去就告诉我。

英文正文: I delivered Dr. Betty's Fossil Report to Dr. Winston in Perion. Along with the report, I also gave him the Leaf, Firewood, Stump's Teardrop, and Weighted Earrings. In return, Dr. Winston gave me the Leaf Earrings.
中文正文: 我把贝蒂博士的化石报告交给了勇士部落的温斯顿博士。除了报告，我还给了他树叶、木柴、古木妖的眼泪和加重耳环。作为回报，温斯顿博士送了我叶子耳环。

英文正文: I took out Stumps for Ayan's sake in Perion. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!
中文正文: 为了阿扬，我在勇士部落清理了古木妖。她终于可以不用担心它们，放心出门了！

英文正文: The tribespeople of Perion got ambushed by the alligator herd at the swamp, so Ayan asked if I could help take care of the alligators. I responded by taking out 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis. Hopefully this will bring some peace back to the swamp.
中文正文: 勇士部落的族人遭到了沼泽鳄鱼群的袭击，阿扬问我能不能帮忙对付鳄鱼。我回应她的方式是消灭了 100 只鳄鱼和 40 只小青蛇。希望这能让沼泽恢复一些平静。

英文正文: At Ayan's request, I took out 120 Crocos in the swamp. I'll have to revisit that spot from time to time and take out the alligators so they don't spawn out of control.
中文正文: 应阿扬的请求，我在沼泽消灭了 120 只鳄鱼。我以后得时不时回那个地方清理鳄鱼，免得它们数量失控。

英文正文: I met Blackbull in Perion. Would he know anything about that tree?
中文正文: 我在勇士部落见到了黑牛。他会知道那棵树的事吗？

英文正文: Asked Ayan about the rumor.
中文正文: 向阿扬打听了那个传言。

英文正文: Asked Manji about the rumor.
中文正文: 向曼吉打听了那个传言。

# 英文标题: Truth of the Rumor- Dances with Balrog
英文正文: Asked Dances with Balrog about the rumor.
中文正文: 向“与巴洛古共舞”打听了那个传言。

英文正文: Asked Doctor Betty about the rumor.
中文正文: 向贝蒂博士打听了那个传言。

英文正文: Told Doctor Winston what the villagers of Perion talked about. Could Stumpy mentioned by Dances with Balrog be the same tree Doctor Betty is looking for?
中文正文: 我把勇士部落村民谈论的事情告诉了温斯顿博士。“与巴洛古共舞”提到的树妖王，会不会就是贝蒂博士在找的那棵树？

英文正文: Gave Doctor Winston the collected Very Dry Branch. Wonder when the research results of Winston will surface?
中文正文: 我把收集到的极干树枝交给了温斯顿博士。不知道温斯顿的研究结果什么时候才能出来？

英文正文: Acting on Doctor Winston's request, I've tracked down and eliminated Stumpy that was nourishing on Perion. Will this help Perion return to its original state?
中文正文: 按照温斯顿博士的请求，我追踪并消灭了在勇士部落作乱的树妖王。这能让勇士部落恢复原样吗？

英文正文: I brought a bunch of Lupin's Bananas for the hungry Ronnie. But it looked like he still wanted to eat more...
中文正文: 我给饿肚子的罗尼带了一大堆香蕉。不过看起来他还想再吃更多……

英文正文: I found Mr. Wetbottom's son, Ronnie, inside a tree tunnel near Ellinia. He declared that he'd never hand over the red book, but he was also pretty hungry. Ronnie asked me to defeat Lupins in the western area of Ellinia and bring back 30 Lupin's Bananas.
中文正文: 在魔法密林附近的树洞里，我找到了泰素夫的儿子洛尼。他说绝不会把红色的书交出来，但看起来相当饿。洛尼让我去魔法密林西部打倒猴子，带回 30 个猴子香蕉。

英文正文: I went to see Rina of Henesys to help feed the hungry Ronnie.
中文正文: 我去射手村找了莉娜，帮忙喂饱饿肚子的罗尼。

英文正文: I brought Rina everything needed to make Rina's Unagi Special.
中文正文: 我把制作“莉娜特制烤鳗鱼”所需的材料全都带给了莉娜。

英文正文: I brought Rina's Unagi Special to Ronnie. That kid sure seemed to enjoy it!
中文正文: 我把莉娜特制烤鳗鱼带给了罗尼。那孩子看起来吃得很开心！

英文正文: I went to see Rowen the Fairy of Ellinia to help quench Ronnie's thirst.
中文正文: 我去魔法密林找妖精罗文，帮忙解罗尼的渴。

英文正文: I brought a Diamond to Rowen the Fairy.
中文正文: 我把一颗钻石带给了妖精罗文。

英文正文: I brought the Fresh Milk to Ronnie. Phew, I guess he's too full to eat any more now!
中文正文: 我把鲜奶带给了罗尼。呼，他大概是吃得太饱，再也吃不下更多了！

英文正文: I got Mr. Wetbottom the precious Secret Book that he'd been desperately looking for. I asked him if he's worried about Ronnie at all, only to hear that he'll be in good hands with the fairies... Well, it'd be best for Ronnie to stay with the fairies, right? Anyway, I got the sauna clothes in return for the book... I guess wearing this cumbersome armor in the sauna is a ridiculous thing to do. Might as well enjoy it now and relax at the sauna...
中文正文: 我帮沃特巴顿先生找回了那本他苦苦寻找的珍贵神秘书。我问他是否担心罗尼，却听说罗尼在妖精那里会被照顾得很好……嗯，罗尼留在妖精身边确实最好，对吧？总之，我用书换来了桑拿服……在桑拿房里穿这么笨重的盔甲，想想也挺荒唐的。既然拿到了，就好好享受一下，在桑拿房里放松放松吧……

# 英文标题: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
中文阶段标题: 【忍耐之林】萨比特拉玛和减肥药
英文正文: Thankfully, I got the flower that Sabitrama wanted from the Forest of Patience, and, as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a scroll for overall armor. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay Shane of Ellinia. From what I've heard, the diet medicine Sabitrama's working on is for Shane's fiance... I should go back to the Forest of Patience when I have some spare time...
中文正文: 谢天谢地，我从忍耐之林拿到了萨比特拉玛想要的花，作为答谢，他给了我一张套服卷轴。哦，他还说从今往后，我进忍耐之林不用再付钱给魔法密林的谢恩了。听说萨比特拉玛正在研制的减肥药是给谢恩的未婚妻用的……有空的时候，我该再回忍耐之林看看……

中文阶段标题: 【忍耐之林】萨比特拉玛的不老药
英文正文: Thankfully, I got the herb that Sabitrama asked me to get, and for that, I was rewarded with a mysterious rock. And from here on out, I don't have to pay Shane every time I go in the Forest of Patience. From what I hear, that anti-aging medicine Sabitrama is working on may be what Shane needed... If I have time, I should go back in there...
中文正文: 谢天谢地，我拿到了萨比特拉玛让我找的草药，作为报酬，得到了一块神秘的石头。而且从今往后，我每次进忍耐之林都不必再付钱给谢恩了。听说萨比特拉玛正在研制的抗衰老药，可能正是谢恩需要的东西……如果有时间，我该再进去看看……

英文正文: As the cave fairy Zelya requested, I defeated the monsters and brought back the fragments of the map of the route to her original home. Hopefully some clues can still be found within them...
中文正文: 按照洞窟妖精泽莉亚的请求，我击败了怪物，带回了通往她故乡路线的地图碎片。希望还能从里面找到一些线索……

英文正文: As Zelya requested, I defeated Raffles and gathered enough Raffle Petals to bring back to her.
中文正文: 按照泽莉亚的请求，我击败了拉弗莱西亚，收集了足够的拉弗莱西亚花瓣带给她。

英文正文: As Zelya requested, I defeated Aqumanders and #o58s. Yet it felt as though monsters continued to pour out from deeper within the cave. What on earth could be happening inside?
中文正文: 按照泽莉亚的请求，我击败了阿库曼德和#o58s。可总觉得洞窟深处还有怪物不断涌出。里面到底发生了什么事？

英文正文: Following Myra's plea, I had no choice but to fell the creatures that were once her companions. How did they end up like this...?
中文正文: 在迈拉的恳求下，我不得不砍倒那些曾是她同伴的生物。它们怎么会变成这样……？

英文正文: When I met Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia, he was astonished to hear that the Forgotten Hollow had been rediscovered, and he seemed deeply troubled about what was happening there.
中文正文: 我在魔法密林见到老格里尔时，他听说被遗忘的洞窟重见天日，十分震惊，似乎也对那里发生的事深感不安。

英文正文: I handed over the Luminous Magical Resonances and reported back to Grendel the Really Old! He confirmed that an ancient seal has fractured, and something buried long ago is waking up.
中文正文: 我把发光的魔法共鸣交给了老格里尔并向他汇报！他确认有一道古老的封印已经破裂，某个被埋藏已久的东西正在苏醒。

英文正文: I cleared out the Duskmanders, and Tamya's fire burns quietly again. She seemed to want to talk about something else, too...
中文正文: 我清理了暮色漫游者，塔米娅的火焰又重新安静地燃烧起来。她似乎还想说点别的事……

英文正文: I brought the Hearthkeeper's Journal to Daniel the Scholar. He recognized the old script right away.
中文正文: 我把守炉人的日志带给了学者丹尼尔。他立刻认出了那种古老的文字。

英文正文: I brought the Giant Tree's Boughs to Jaime the Wandering Explorer. He will build the lantern frames and guide the way to Map 010006161 once I am strong enough.
中文正文: 我把巨树的枝条带给了流浪探险家杰米。他会制作灯笼框架，等我足够强大时为我指路前往地图 010006161。

英文正文: I brought the Decayed Charms to Jaime the Wandering Explorer. While cleaning them, he found one with the same mark as the cover of Elda's journal.
中文正文: 我把腐朽的护符带给了流浪探险家杰米。在清理它们时，他发现其中一枚上的记号与艾尔达日志的封面相同。

英文正文: I cleared the Sporewoods, and Jaime the Wandering Explorer put the charms back on the tomb walls. I gave the Elda's Name-Charm to Daniel the Scholar.
中文正文: 我清理了孢子林，流浪探险家杰米把护符重新挂回了墓穴墙壁上。我把艾尔达的名牌护符交给了学者丹尼尔。

英文正文: Tamya heard her grandmother's last words. She lit a lantern at her campfire and held the Lantern Rite. She keeps the fire now, as a hearthkeeper.
中文正文: 塔米娅听到了祖母的遗言。她在营火旁点起一盏灯笼，举行了灯笼祭。如今她作为守炉人，继续守护着这团火。

中文阶段标题: 黄金海岸的特别味道 I
英文正文: I brought back fresh Coconuts just like Riel said. Riel told me I can come back for work anytime I want. I guess I won't be starving here in Florina Beach.

# 英文标题: Special Taste of Florina Beach III
英文正文: I worked a part-time gig gathering ingredients for meals for the tourists coming to Florina Beach.
中文正文: 我在弗洛里纳海滩打零工，为来这里的游客收集做饭用的食材。

英文正文: I was familiar with working in Florina Beach, so I visited Riel one more time and helped her out. Why is she so desperate to help Valen?
中文正文: 我已经熟悉弗洛里纳海滩的工作了，于是又去找莉尔帮了一次忙。她为什么这么拼命想帮瓦伦呢？

英文正文: If it's Elma the Housekeeper, she should know about what was stolen from Hella, right?
中文正文: 如果是管家艾尔玛，应该知道海拉那里被偷了什么东西吧？

英文正文: Scadur seemed to know something after receiving the Old Ring.
中文正文: 斯卡杜收到旧戒指后，似乎知道了些什么。

英文正文: Dances with Balrog of Perion seemed surprised to see how much stronger I had become compared to before.
中文正文: 勇士部落的“与巴洛古共舞”看到我比以前强大了许多，显得很惊讶。

英文正文: In West Rocky Mountain IV, I met Warrior Job Instructor. He said he would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told him I was ready for anything!
中文正文: 我在西部岩山 IV 遇到了战士转职教官。他说要测试我是否有资格进行第二次转职。太好了！我告诉他，我什么都准备好了！

中文正文: 我在西部岩山 IV 通过了战士转职教官的测试！

英文正文: Dances with Balrog in Perion welcomed me warmly, and I gained a new job, obtaining even greater power!

英文正文: Grendel the Really Old said that if I can pass his test, he'll gladly teach me more. I'm no longer the weakling I once was, but hearing that I still have to face a trial makes me a bit nervous.

# 英文标题: [Event] The One Who Sealed the Darkness
英文正文: I couldn't get any answers from Manji... but I was able to see the battle he fought beneath the World Tree.
中文正文: 我没能从曼吉那里得到任何答案……但我看到了他在世界树下经历的那场战斗。

中文正文: 你的淡枫叶长成了一片红叶！

中文正文: 所有万圣节糖果都已归还给玛拉迪。万圣节恢复了正常。

中文正文: 玛拉迪遵守了诺言，把奖励交给了我。

中文正文: 我在射手村市政厅遇到的镇书记官亚瑟建议我成为射手村的居民。等我下定决心，就去找亚瑟详谈。

中文正文: 我收集了城市书记官罗克西要的东西，并带给了她。很高兴能为小镇的发展出一份力。

英文正文: I went to see Mong from Kong to help cure the fear of Stirge that Jake, who works at the subway entrance in Kerning City, is suffering from.
中文正文: 我去找了孔中孔，帮忙治疗废弃都市地铁入口的杰克对蝙蝠怪的恐惧症。

# 英文标题: The Final Ingredient for the Cure
英文正文: Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor handed over the Vitamin Gummy with a suspicious look. Will this really be, okay?

中文正文: 我把治疗蝙蝠怪恐惧症的所有材料都交给了废弃都市的孔中孔。现在只能希望他把药做对了。

英文正文: I delivered the Special Stirge Phobia Cure crafted by Mong from Kong to Jake at the subway entrance in Kerning City. Truth be told, it seems like a medicine with little to no actual effect, but if it gave Jake the courage he needed, perhaps that is enough.
中文正文: 我把孔中孔特制的蝙蝠怪恐惧症药交给了废弃都市地铁入口的杰克。说实话，那药似乎没什么实际效果，但如果它能给杰克带来勇气，也许这就够了。

英文正文: I gathered Tablecloths for Jane Doe. I only wish she hadn't asked me to help her change those bandages..
中文正文: 我为简·多伊收集了桌布。真希望她没让我帮她换那些绷带……

英文正文: I met Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center. She clearly seems to know something.
中文正文: 我在废弃都市市民中心见到了罗克西。她显然知道些什么。

英文正文: I went to meet Nella to try and track down Dr. Niora's whereabouts. I do hope I can get some useful information out of this.
中文正文: 我去找内拉，想追查尼奥拉博士的下落。真希望能从她那里得到一些有用的情报。

英文正文: I brought Nella what she'd asked for. Now it's time to hear what she knows.
中文正文: 我把内拉要的东西带给了她。现在该听听她知道些什么了。

英文正文: I met Jane Doe and told her everything I'd learned. It seemed she'd finally, however painfully, come to understand that Niora was never coming back to this hospital.
中文正文: 我见到了简·多伊，把我查到的一切都告诉了她。她似乎终于明白，无论多么痛苦，尼奥拉再也不会回到这家医院了。

英文正文: Claim all 14 rewards and your first step will be complete.
中文正文: 领取全部 14 份奖励，你的第一步就完成了。

中文正文: 每天击败怪物即可领取当天的礼物。礼物每天都会不同。

英文正文: Whatever is left of it, the first page is where this starts.
中文正文: 无论剩下什么，故事都从第一页开始。

中文正文: 冒险者日志的第二页归我了。留下这条线索的人，一定是希望有人追下去。

英文正文: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 3 is mine.
中文正文: 冒险者日志的第三页归我了。

英文正文: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 4 is mine.
中文正文: 冒险者日志的第四页归我了。

中文正文: 冒险者日志的第五页归我了。还剩两页。

英文正文: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 6 is mine. One page left!
中文正文: 冒险者日志的第六页归我了。还剩一页！

英文正文: So that is what the log meant. The mark is mine now, and the next one is mine to leave.
中文正文: 原来那本日志是这个意思。这个印记现在归我了，而下一个该由我来留下。

# 英文标题: Mar the Fairy and the Water of Life
英文正文: After easily passing the test Trainer Bartos of Henesys gave me, I got a hold of the Water of Life and Life Scroll and got them to Mar the Fairy. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now... Sweet...

中文正文: 我通过了勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯给出的考验。这是否意味着我能在冒险岛世界成为一名真正的铁匠了？

# 英文标题: A Blacksmith in My Own Right!
中文阶段标题: 我也是独当一面的铁匠了！
英文正文: Silas Irons, the master craftsman of Perion, was amazed by my work and handed me a Armor Crafting Catalyst. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter the stats of equipment. Maybe I should give it a try.
中文正文: 勇士部落的锻造大师西拉斯·艾恩斯对我的手艺惊叹不已，还把一块盔甲锻造催化剂交给了我。那似乎是锻造时能改变装备属性的特殊道具。也许我该试试看。

# 英文标题: Mr. Thunder in Need of an Apprentice
英文正文: I passed the test Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, gave me. Does this mean I can now become a true weapon craftsman of Maple World?

# 英文标题: Mr. Thunder in Need of Help

中文正文: 我顺利地把雷霆先生要的物品交给了他。照这个势头，我说不定真会被当成一名出色的学徒。

# 英文标题: JM From tha Streetz in Need of Help
英文正文: I was able to safely deliver the items requested by the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City. At this point, wouldn't I qualify as a reliable partner?
中文正文: 我顺利地把废弃都市的制皮大师街头混混JM要的物品交给了他。到了这个地步，我难道还不能算是一名可靠的伙伴吗？

中文阶段标题: 我也是独当一面的炼金术士了！

中文正文: 林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛对我的手艺惊叹不已，还把一块卷轴锻造催化剂交给了我。那似乎是锻造时能制作更强卷轴的特殊道具。我该试试吗？

英文正文: I was able to safely deliver the item requested by the Arcforging master Chrishrama of Sleepywood. Does this mean I can now be called his true apprentice?
中文正文: 我顺利地把林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛要的东西交给了他。这是否意味着我现在能被称为他真正的学徒了？

英文正文: I delivered Lewis's letter to Chief Stan in Henesys.
中文正文: 我把刘易斯的信交给了射手村的村长斯坦。

英文正文: I delivered Chief Stan's letter to Lewis in the Free Market Entrance.
中文正文: 我把村长斯坦的回信交给了自由市场入口的刘易斯。

英文正文: I delivered Lewis's letter to Dances with Balrog in Perion.
中文正文: 我把刘易斯的信交给了勇士部落的“与巴洛古共舞”。

英文正文: I delivered Dances with Balrog's letter to Lewis in the Free Market Entrance.
中文正文: 我把“与巴洛古共舞”的回信交给了自由市场入口的刘易斯。

英文正文: Ronnie said that the Lupin's Bananas weren't enough for him and asked me to go see Rina at Henesys to get a plate of Rina's Unagi Special.
中文正文: 罗尼说那些猴子香蕉还不够，让我去射手村找莉娜，要一盘莉娜特制烤鳗鱼。

英文正文: Midnight Rest Quest
中文正文: 午夜休息任务

英文正文: Heard Pia in Henesys got her hands on a strange book. What kind of book could it be? Let’s go see her.
中文正文: 听说射手村的皮娅弄到了一本奇怪的书。会是什么书呢？去看看她吧。

英文正文: The book is about the Oldest Snail in Maple World and its Rainbow-colored Snail Shell. It looks like Pia is interested in the snail’s shell because it makes wishes come true. Jay is the original owner of the book; he must know something about the author. Let’s go see him.
中文正文: 那本书讲的是冒险岛世界里最古老的蜗牛和它那彩虹色的蜗牛壳。看来皮娅是冲着那蜗牛壳能让愿望成真才感兴趣的。杰伊是这本书原来的主人，他一定知道些关于作者的事。去见见他吧。

英文正文: Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys seems to have something to tell you.
中文正文: 射手村的明明夫人似乎有话要对你说。

英文正文: Took Jay’s advice and visited Mrs. Ming Ming to ask about Alloy, the author of The Snail Legend. She said her grandfather’s latest letter was about Wing, the Fairy of Ellinia, and suggested I go see Wing the Fairy.
中文正文: 我听了杰伊的建议，去拜访明明夫人，打听《蜗牛传说》的作者阿洛伊。她说她祖父最近的一封信里提到了魔法密林的妖精温，还建议我去找妖精温。

英文正文: Would Wing the Fairy in Ellinia know anything about the Alloy...?
中文正文: 魔法密林的妖精温会知道阿洛伊的事吗……？

英文正文: Wing the Fairy not only knew about Alloy, but also knew of Mano, the snail with the Rainbow-colored Snail Shell. Wing offered to reveal Mano’s location on one condition: bring him some snail shells.
中文正文: 妖精温不但知道阿洛伊，还知道那只背着彩虹色蜗牛壳的蜗牛马诺。温说只要我办到一件事，他就告诉我马诺在哪儿：给他带些蜗牛壳来。

英文正文: I learned a lot from Wing the Fairy in Ellinia.
中文正文: 我从魔法密林的妖精温那里打听到了不少东西。

英文正文: Wing the Fairy in Ellinia told me that Mano has been spotted in the thicket around the beach near Lith Harbor. Time to head back to Pia in Henesys.
中文正文: 魔法密林的妖精温告诉我，有人在明珠港附近海滩边的灌木丛里见过马诺。该回射手村找皮娅了。

# 英文标题: A rainbow snail shell that makes wishes come true!?
中文阶段标题: 能实现愿望的彩虹色蜗牛壳儿！？
英文正文: Looks like Pia has another favor to ask.
中文正文: 看来皮娅又有事要拜托我了。

# 英文标题: A rainbow snail shell that makes wishes come true!?
中文阶段标题: 能实现愿望的彩虹色蜗牛壳儿！？
英文正文: Pia asked me to go to Thicket Around the Beach III, take out Mano, and bring back its Rainbow-colored Snail Shell. So you get to stay here while I do all the work for you again? Don't you think that's a bit much? Maybe I'll just keep the Rainbow-colored Snail Shell for myself!
中文正文: 皮娅让我去海滩附近的灌木丛 III 干掉马诺，把它的彩虹色蜗牛壳带回来。所以你又打算待在这儿，让我替你把活全干了？你不觉得有点过分吗？也许我就把彩虹色蜗牛壳自己留下了！

英文正文: Rumor has it there is a hidden room above the Magic Library... I should keep an eye out for it next time I'm in there.
中文正文: 听说魔法图书馆上方有一间隐藏的房间……下次去那里时，我得多留意一下。

英文正文: Chief Stan stamped the cover, but he doesn't want me returning to Lyn the Librarian with a damaged book.
中文正文: 村长斯坦在封面上盖了章，但他不愿让我拿着一本破损的书回去找图书管理员琳。

英文正文: Chief Stan asked me to speak to him again about the pages I retrieved for Lyn the Librarian.
中文正文: 村长斯坦让我再去找他谈谈，说说我为图书管理员琳找回的那些书页。

英文正文: Chief Stan made out one word in the damaged pages. He sent me to Manji in Perion.
中文正文: 村长斯坦从破损的书页里认出了一个词，便让我去勇士部落找曼吉。

英文正文: Manji recognized the handwriting and remembered part of the entry. He asked me to speak with him again once I was ready.
中文正文: 曼吉认出了那个笔迹，也想起了那段记录的一部分。他让我准备好之后再去找他。

英文正文: Manji asked me to speak with him again about the ledger.
中文正文: 曼吉让我再去找他谈谈账本的事。

英文正文: Manji thought Chrishrama in Sleepywood might be able to repair the pages.
中文正文: 曼吉觉得林中之城的克莉丝拉玛也许能修好书页。

英文正文: Chrishrama agreed to work on the ledger. He asked me to come back once he'd made a start.
中文正文: 克莉丝拉玛答应修补账本。他让我等他动手之后再回去。

英文正文: Chrishrama is working on the ledger. I should see how far he's gotten.
中文正文: 克莉丝拉玛正在修补账本。我该去看看他进行到哪一步了。

英文正文: Chrishrama rebound the ledger but couldn't restore one long entry. He sent me to the Hotel Receptionist, who keeps records of her own.
中文正文: 克莉丝拉玛重新装订了账本，却没能还原其中一段很长的记录。他让我去找旅馆接待员，她自己也存着一些记录。

英文正文: The Hotel Receptionist couldn't decode the long entry at all. She directed me to Kerning City to speak with the Dark Lord.
中文正文: 旅馆接待员完全看不懂那段长记录，便打发我去废弃都市找黑暗领主。

英文正文: The receptionist sent the ledger ahead to Kerning City for me. The long entry names the Dark Lord, but parts of it are missing.
中文正文: 接待员先把账本送去了废弃都市。那段长记录里提到了黑暗领主，但有几处已经缺失。

英文正文: Dark Lord found his own name in the ledger and didn't care for it. He couldn't tell me much, but he sent me to Alex on the rooftops.
中文正文: 黑暗领主在账本里看到了自己的名字，显然不太高兴。他没能告诉我太多，只让我去屋顶上找亚历克斯。

英文正文: Alex filled in the part about the bench. Now to make my way to Grendel the Really Old.
中文正文: 亚历克斯补上了关于长椅的那一段。接下来，我得去找长老格雷德尔了。

英文正文: Alex sent the ledger ahead to Grendel the Really Old in the Magic Library. The oldest part of the entry names him.
中文正文: 亚历克斯先把账本送去了魔法图书馆，交给长老格雷德尔。那段记录最古老的部分里提到了他。

英文正文: Grendel the Really Old read the whole entry and couldn't make sense of it. He told me to take the ledger back up to Lyn the Librarian and ask her what it means.
中文正文: 长老格雷德尔读完了整段记录，却也弄不明白。他让我把账本送回楼上，去问图书管理员琳那到底是什么意思。

英文正文: Lyn the Librarian explained what the entry really is, and she has written me into the registry.
中文正文: 图书管理员琳讲清了那段记录的来历，还把我的名字写进了登记册。

英文正文: The archeologist, Doctor Winston, currently does research at a camping site in East Rocky Mountain II. He recently called me about a strange rumor he heard.
中文正文: 考古学家温斯顿博士目前正在东部岩石山II的营地做研究。他最近联系我，说听到了一个奇怪的传闻。

英文正文: During the excavation, Doctor Winston said he heard a rumor about a very old tree living in Perion. However, he had no clue on what kind of tree it was, or where exactly it was located. That's why he's asked me to visit Perion village to collect information on this particular tree. Shall I start by visiting Blackbull?
中文正文: 温斯顿博士说，他在挖掘时听到一个传闻，说勇士部落里有一棵非常古老的树。可他既不知道那是什么树，也不清楚它究竟长在哪里。所以他让我去勇士部落的村子里打听这棵树的消息。要不要先从黑牛问起呢？

英文正文: Let's ask Blackbull in Perion if there's anyone who might know more.
中文正文: 去勇士部落向布莱克布尔打听，看有没有人知道得更多。

英文正文: Ayan lived in Perion for a long time. Let's go ask about the rumor.
中文正文: 阿扬在勇士部落住了很久。去向他打听那个传言吧。

英文正文: Let's ask Ayan in Perion if there's anyone who might know more.
中文正文: 去勇士部落向阿扬打听，看有没有人知道得更多。

英文正文: Manji has been training at Perion for a long time. Let's go and ask about the rumor.
中文正文: 曼吉在勇士部落修炼了很久。去向他打听那个传言吧。

# 英文标题: Truth of the Rumor- Dances with Balrog
英文正文: Let's ask Manji in Perion if there's anyone who might know more.
中文正文: 去勇士部落向曼吉打听，看有没有人知道得更多。

# 英文标题: Truth of the Rumor- Dances with Balrog
英文正文: Let's ask elder Dances with Balrog in Perion about the rumor.
中文正文: 去勇士部落向长老与巴洛古共舞打听那个传言吧。

英文正文: Let's ask Dances with Balrog in Perion if there's anyone who might know more.
中文正文: 去勇士部落向与巴洛古共舞打听，看有没有人知道得更多。

英文正文: Let's ask botanist Betty in Ellinia about the rumor.
中文正文: 去魔法密林向植物学家贝蒂博士打听那个传言吧。

英文正文: Botanist Betty in Ellinia seems to have a suggestion.
中文正文: 魔法密林的植物学家贝蒂博士似乎有话要说。

英文正文: Botanist Betty in Ellinia suggested that I take all the information I've gathered so far to Archaeologist Winston in East Rocky Mountain II.
中文正文: 魔法密林的植物学家贝蒂博士建议我，把目前收集到的所有情报都带去东部岩山II给考古学家温斯顿博士。

英文正文: Doctor Winston seems to have another request.
中文正文: 温斯顿博士似乎还有别的请求。

英文正文: Doctor Winston thought the reason why all the stumps in Perion were dry was due to Stumpy. To prove his theory, he wanted to do research on the Stumps' Very Dry Branch.
中文正文: 温斯顿博士认为，勇士部落的树桩之所以全部干枯，都是树妖王造成的。为了证明自己的推测，他想研究树桩的极干树枝。

英文正文: Doctor Winston seems to have one last request.
中文正文: 温斯顿博士似乎还有最后一个请求。

英文正文: Visited Doctor Winston again. He says Stumpy seems to take all the nutrients from Perion. He also added that if this continues, Perion would become a wasteland devoid of life. The Stumpy must be eliminated.
中文正文: 我再次拜访了温斯顿博士。他说树妖王似乎吸走了勇士部落所有的养分，还说若继续这样下去，勇士部落会变成毫无生机的荒地。必须消灭树妖王。

英文正文: Grendel the Really Old confirmed that an ancient seal has broken, but he cannot pinpoint the exact location. He needs me to speak to Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia.
中文正文: 老格里尔确认有一道古老的封印已经破裂，但他无法确定确切位置。他让我去和魔法密林的妖精阿雯谈谈。

英文正文: Grendel the Really Old asked me to speak with Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia. While he is human, the fairies are native to the forest and can naturally sense the distress of the ancient woods.
中文正文: 老格里尔让我去和魔法密林的妖精阿雯谈谈。他虽是人类，但妖精是森林的原住民，天生就能感知古老树林的悲鸣。

英文正文: I approached Arwen the Fairy. She immediately smelled the dark magic clinging to me and demanded I stay back.
中文正文: 我走近妖精阿雯。她立刻闻到了我身上附着的暗黑魔法，叫我别靠近。

英文正文: The ambient dark energy is too overwhelming to track blindly. Arwen the Fairy asked me to hunt Cold Eyes in the forest and gather 25 Rotten Root Fragments to use as an alchemical tracking focus.
中文正文: 四周弥漫的暗黑能量太过浓烈，无法盲目追踪。妖精阿雯让我去森林里猎杀冷眼，收集25块腐烂的根碎片，用作炼金追踪的媒介。

英文正文: Arwen the Fairy agreed to help, but the ambient dark energy is too overwhelming to track blindly. She asked me to hunt Cold Eyes in the cursed forest and gather 25 Rotten Root Fragment to use as an alchemical tracking focus.
中文正文: 妖精阿雯答应帮忙，可周围弥漫的暗黑能量太过浓烈，无法盲目追踪。她让我去被诅咒的森林猎杀冷眼，收集25块腐烂的根碎片，用作炼金追踪的媒介。

英文正文: I brought the Rotten Root Fragments back to Arwen the Fairy. By using them as a tracking focus, she pinpointed a magical disturbance in the forest. She urged me to speak with her again immediately to help her trace the exact location.
中文正文: 我把腐烂的根碎片带回给妖精阿雯。她以这些碎片作为追踪媒介，锁定了森林里的一处魔力异动。她催我立刻再去找她，好帮她追查确切的位置。

英文正文: Arwen the Fairy successfully tracked the resonance toward the deep northern woods. She wants me to deliver this terrifying news to Grendel the Really Old.
中文正文: 妖精阿雯成功把那道共鸣追踪到了北方的密林深处。她要我把这个骇人的消息带给老格里尔。

英文正文: I must speak with Grendel the Really Old. I need to tell him that Arwen the Fairy tracked the dark resonance directly to The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North.
中文正文: 我必须去找老格里尔。我要告诉他，妖精阿雯把暗黑共鸣一路追到了北部森林的树洞。

英文正文: I delivered Arwen's findings to Grendel the Really Old. Upon hearing the location, he realized an ancient barrier has been ripped open. The entrance to the Forgotten Hollow is revealed.
中文正文: 我把阿雯的调查结果告诉了老格里尔。一听地点，他就意识到一道古老的结界已被撕开。被遗忘的洞窟的入口就此显现。

英文正文: Grendel the Really Old revealed that his kin were sealed away in the dark. There must be a place where the fairies still live within the Forgotten Hollow.
中文正文: 老格里尔透露，他的族人被封印在黑暗之中。被遗忘的洞窟里，一定还有妖精居住的地方。

英文正文: I must travel to The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North, find the newly opened abyss, and descend into the Forgotten Hollow to see what remains of the fairy homeland.
中文正文: 我必须赶往北部森林的树洞，找到新近洞开的深渊，下到被遗忘的洞窟，看看妖精的故乡还剩下些什么。

英文正文: I descended into the Hollow and met an eccentric fairy named Nyroth, who chose to stay behind in the dark decades ago.
中文正文: 我下到洞窟深处，遇到了一位古怪的妖精尼洛斯。几十年前，他选择留在了那片黑暗里。

英文正文: Nyroth is trying to Arcforge a protection scroll using rot-steeped catalysts. Maybe he needs some help?
中文正文: 尼洛斯正试着用浸泡过腐质的触媒秘法锻造一张保护卷轴。也许他需要帮手？

英文正文: I need to venture deeper into the dark tunnels, hunt the corrupted Rafflesias, and bring back 20 Rafflesia Petals for Nyroth's Arcforge.
中文正文: 我需要深入黑暗的隧道，猎杀被腐化的拉弗莱西亚，为尼洛斯的秘法锻造带回20片拉弗莱西亚花瓣。

英文正文: I brought the petals to Nyroth, but the rot within them swallowed his forging fire. The failed synthesis produced a Scorched Arcon Scroll.
中文正文: 我把花瓣交给尼洛斯，可花瓣里的腐质吞灭了他的锻造之火。失败的合成只产出一张焦黑的阿尔孔卷轴。

英文正文: The rot swallowed Nyroth's forging fire. Realizing the sickness is a living malice, he wants me to take the scorched scroll to the alchemist Jaime the Wandering Explorer.
中文正文: 腐质吞灭了尼洛斯的锻造之火。他意识到这场病害是一种有生命的恶意，想让我把那张焦黑的卷轴带给炼金术士流浪探险家杰米。

英文正文: I need to deliver the Scorched Arcon Scroll to Jaime the Wandering Explorer in Decayed Tunnel III to see if he can explain the living malice.
中文正文: 我需要把焦黑的阿尔孔卷轴送到腐朽隧道 III，交给那里的流浪探险家杰米，看他能否解释这种有生命的恶意。

英文正文: I delivered the scroll to Jaime the Wandering Explorer. He was fascinated by the volatile anomaly and agreed to investigate.
中文正文: 我把卷轴交给了流浪探险家杰米。他对这种不稳定的异常很感兴趣，答应着手调查。

英文正文: I need to let Jaime the Wandering Explorer analyze the scorched scroll to see if his alchemy can explain why Nyroth's machinery failed against the living malice.
中文正文: 我需要让流浪探险家杰米分析那张焦黑的卷轴，看他的炼金术能否解释尼洛斯的机械为何敌不过这种有生命的恶意。

英文正文: Jaime the Wandering Explorer discovered the soil is skewed by rusted iron from Tristan's ancient battle with the Balrog. I must defeat 50 Echopuss to clear the toxic air.
中文正文: 流浪探险家杰米发现，土壤被锈铁侵染了，那是特里斯坦当年与巴洛古之战留下的。我必须击败50只埃科帕斯，净化这有毒的空气。

英文正文: I purged the Echopuss from the area honoring Tristan's memory and clearing the toxicity. But the living malice, Caligo, lies deeper.
中文正文: 我清除了这一带的埃科帕斯，既告慰了特里斯坦，也除去了毒性。但那有生命的恶意——卡利戈——还藏在更深处。

# 英文标题: A Heart of Stillness and Wood
英文正文: I must find Daniel the Scholar in Precipice of Darkness and tell him that the iron corruption has been purged, making the tree bark pure enough for a magical seal.
中文正文: 我必须去黑暗绝壁找到学者丹尼尔，告诉他铁锈的污染已经清除，树皮已经纯净到足以承载魔法封印。

# 英文标题: A Heart of Stillness and Wood
英文正文: Daniel the Scholar, a friendly mediator for the fairies, explained that the living malice Caligo has consumed the Arcon. To hide the fairies home from Caligo's gaze, he needs to cast an invisible Stasis Seal. I must gather 30 Cursed Dolls and 20 Duskmander Tails from the deeper chambers.
中文正文: 学者丹尼尔是妖精们友善的调停人。他解释说，那有生命的恶意卡利戈已经吞噬了阿尔孔。为了让妖精的家园避开卡利戈的视线，他需要施放一道无形的静滞封印。我必须到更深的洞窟里收集30个诅咒娃娃和20条暮色漫游者的尾巴。

# 英文标题: A Heart of Stillness and Wood
英文正文: I delivered the catalysts to Daniel the Scholar, who successfully wove the invisible Stasis Seal. The corrupted beasts still roam, but the World Tree's roots have stopped decaying and the fairies are hidden from Caligo's sight. The true battle lies ahead, but we have bought them time.
中文正文: 我把触媒交给了学者丹尼尔，他成功织出了无形的静滞封印。被腐化的野兽仍在游荡，但世界树的根须已经停止腐烂，妖精们也躲过了卡利戈的视线。真正的战斗还在前方，但我们为他们争取到了时间。

英文正文: The Stasis Seal is only a temporary measure. Daniel the Scholar asked me to speak with him about warning the fairies on the surface.
中文正文: 静滞封印只是权宜之计。学者丹尼尔让我去找他谈谈，商量如何向地面的妖精们示警。

英文正文: I must travel back up to the Magic Library and deliver the truth to Grendel the Really Old before the Sages are caught completely off guard.
中文正文: 我必须回到上面的魔法图书馆，赶在贤者们完全措手不及之前，把真相告诉老格里尔。

英文正文: I returned to Ellinia and warned Grendel the Really Old. He was relieved to hear the Cave Fairies survived, but realized the Sages must prepare for the corrupted Arcon. He thanked me for buying them time.
中文正文: 我回到魔法密林，向老格里尔发出了警告。听说洞窟妖精还活着，他松了口气，却也意识到贤者们必须为被腐化的阿尔孔做好准备。他感谢我为他们争取了时间。

# 英文标题: A Heart of Stillness and Wood
英文正文: Daniel the Scholar, a friendly mediator for the fairies, explained that the living malice Caligo has consumed the Arcon. To hide the fairies' home from Caligo's gaze, he needs to cast an invisible Stasis Seal. I must gather 30 Cursed Dolls and 20 Duskmander Tails from the deeper chambers.
中文正文: 学者丹尼尔是妖精们友善的调停人。他解释说，那有生命的恶意卡利戈已经吞噬了阿尔孔。为了让妖精的家园避开卡利戈的视线，他需要施放一道无形的静滞封印。我必须到更深的洞窟里收集30个诅咒娃娃和20条暮色漫游者的尾巴。

英文正文: A cave fairy named Tamya keeps a campfire burning in Collision of Ice and Fire. She looks like she could use a hand.
中文正文: 冰火交汇之地，一位名叫塔米娅的洞窟妖精守着一堆篝火。她看起来需要帮手。

英文正文: Tamya says Duskmanders keep crawling up from Perilous Descent II toward her campfire. Defeat 60 Duskmanders so the camp stays safe.
中文正文: 塔米娅说，暮色漫游者不断从险峻的下降II爬向她的篝火。击败60只暮色漫游者，让营地保持安全。

英文正文: Tamya has something she wants to share.
中文正文: 塔米娅有些事想告诉我。

英文正文: Tamya can't read her grandmother's journal. It's written in the old fairy script. Take the Hearthkeeper's Journal to Daniel the Scholar in Precipice of Darkness.
中文正文: 塔米娅读不懂祖母留下的日志，那上面写的是古老的妖精文字。把守炉人的日志带去黑暗绝壁，交给学者丹尼尔。

英文正文: Daniel the Scholar has finished reading Elda's journal.
中文正文: 学者丹尼尔读完了艾尔达的日志。

英文正文: For the Lantern Rite, the hearthkeepers built lantern frames from boughs the Myewoods gave freely. Collect 30 Giant Tree's Boughs from Myewoods and bring them to Jaime the Wandering Explorer in Decayed Tunnel III. He knows the way to the old tomb.
中文正文: 为了灯笼节，守炉人们用迈伍德甘愿献出的枝条搭起灯笼框架。去迈伍德那里收集30根巨树的枝条，送到腐朽隧道 III 的流浪探险家杰米手中。他知道通往那座古墓的路。

英文正文: I brought the Giant Tree's Boughs to Jaime the Wandering Explorer. He will build the lantern frames and guide the way to Dilapidated Tomb once I am strong enough.
中文正文: 我把巨树的枝条交给了流浪探险家杰米。他会搭好灯笼框架，等我足够强大时为我指路前往地图 010006161。

英文正文: Jaime the Wandering Explorer has finished the lantern frames and is ready to head for the old tomb.
中文正文: 流浪探险家杰米已经做好灯笼框架，准备前往那座古墓。

英文正文: The Rotten Mushrooms have scattered the old name-charms all over the deep tunnels. Collect 30 Decayed Charms from them in Precipice of Darkness and Dilapidated Tomb, and bring them to Jaime the Wandering Explorer.
中文正文: 腐烂蘑菇把那些古老的名牌护符散落到了深层隧道的各处。在黑暗绝壁和地图 010006161 从腐烂蘑菇身上收集30个腐朽的护符，交给流浪探险家杰米。

英文正文: Jaime the Wandering Explorer found a charm marked with Elda's sign.
中文正文: 流浪探险家杰米找到了一枚刻有艾尔达记号的护符。

英文正文: Jaime the Wandering Explorer wants to return the other charms to Dilapidated Tomb. Defeat 60 Sporewoods there so he can work safely, then take the Elda's Name-Charm to Daniel the Scholar in Precipice of Darkness so he can read it.
中文正文: 流浪探险家杰米想把其余的护符重新挂回破败墓穴。为了让他能在那儿安稳干活，我得先消灭 60 只孢子木，然后把艾尔达的名牌护符带去黑暗悬崖，交给学者丹尼尔解读。

英文正文: Daniel the Scholar has read Elda's message.
中文正文: 学者丹尼尔读懂了艾尔达留下的遗言。

英文正文: Bring Elda's Last Message back to Tamya in Collision of Ice and Fire.
中文正文: 把艾尔达的遗言带回冰火交汇之地，交给塔米娅。

英文正文: I heard there is an old man called Huckle inside a hidden secret room in Orbis Tower...
中文正文: 听说天空之城塔里有一间隐蔽的密室，里面住着一位叫哈克尔的老人……

中文阶段标题: 收集哈克尔的魔法材料
英文正文: I met an old man named Huckle at the hidden room in the middle of Orbis Tower. He's been living in there for 30 years, studying the physics of the self-moving stones. He wants me to gather up 30 Jr. Sentinel Shellpieces, 15 Ice Sentinel Shellpieces, and 15 Fire Sentinel Shellpieces. Alright, let's do this...
中文正文: 我在天空之城塔中段的密室里见到了一位叫哈克尔的老人。他在那儿住了 30 年，一直在研究自行移动的石球的原理。他要我收集 30 个小石球碎片、15 个冰石球碎片和 15 个火石球碎片。好吧，那就动手吧……

中文阶段标题: 收集哈克尔的魔法材料
英文正文: I got Huckle, the old man living in the hidden room at the Orbis Tower, the items he had requested, and got Orbis Rock Scrolls in return. They allow me to teleport between the rocks at the 15th and 1st floors of Orbis Tower. Huckle looks like he needs more samples, so I guess I'll need to keep looking for them...
中文正文: 我把哈克尔要的东西交给了这位住在天空之城塔密室的老人，换回了天空之城岩石卷轴。有了它，我就能在天空之城塔 15 层与 1 层的岩石之间传送。哈克尔似乎还需要更多样本，看来我还得继续替他留意……

英文正文: Let's go see Master Sergeant Fox in El Nath.
中文正文: 去冰峰雪域见珀斯上尉吧。

英文正文: Master Sergeant Fox, whom I met in El Nath, asked me to meet Staff Sergeant Charlie, Sergeant Bravo, and Corporal Easy in order, and then return. I should go find Staff Sergeant Charlie first, who is somewhere on the Ossyria. He said Staff Sergeant Charlie hates the cold, so he must have gone up the tower.
中文正文: 我在冰峰雪域见到的珀斯上尉让我按顺序去见查里中士、巴伯下士和伊吉上等兵，然后再回去复命。我得先找到查里中士，他就在奥西利亚的某个地方。珀斯上尉说查里中士怕冷，那他一定是往塔上去了。

英文正文: I found Staff Sergeant Charlie in Orbis!
中文正文: 我在天空之城找到了查里中士！

# 英文标题: A Request from Staff Sergeant Charlie

中文正文: 我在天空之城遇到的查里中士让我把他执行任务时找到的一份文件送去冰峰雪域，交给珀斯上尉。

# 英文标题: A Report from Staff Sergeant Charlie
英文正文: As Staff Sergeant Charlie requested, I delivered the document to Master Sergeant Fox in El Nath.
中文正文: 我按查里中士的嘱托，把文件送到了冰峰雪域的珀斯上尉手上。

英文正文: Master Sergeant Fox, whom I met in El Nath, asked me to find Sergeant Bravo this time.
中文正文: 我在冰峰雪域见到的珀斯上尉这次让我去找巴伯下士。

英文正文: I found Sergeant Bravo in Icy Cold Field!
中文正文: 我在冰冷地带找到了巴伯下士！

中文正文: 我该先找到巴伯下士，他就在奥西利亚的某个地方。

英文正文: I found Sergeant Bravo at Icy Cold Field, and he asked me to get him 4 refined Adamantium Ingots while giving me an item to give to Master Sergeant Fox.

英文正文: I gave Adamantium Ingot to Sergeant Bravo. What would he give Master Sergeant Fox?
