# 英文标题: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel
中文阶段标题: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel
英文正文: I met with Luke at the entrance of the dungeon again. The Snake Drink from back then was completely gone... because he and his mom drank it all... Ah, well. Luke said he was over the boring life of a security guard and has decided to go on an adventure. To make a glove fit for the journey, Silas Irons of Perion is asking for 1 Black Feather, 10 Orihalcon Ingots, 30 Drake Skulls, 20 Dragon Skins, and 20 Screws! He wants me to gather them for him... The fairies of Ellinia might know something about the Black Feather.
中文正文: 我又在地下城入口见到了卢克。上次那瓶蛇酒早就没了……因为他和他母亲一起喝完了……唉，算了。卢克说他已经厌倦了无聊的警卫生活，决定踏上冒险之旅。为了做一副适合旅行的手套，勇士部落的赛拉斯·艾恩斯需要1根黑色羽毛、10块奥里哈康锭、30个德雷克头骨、20张龙皮和20个螺丝！他让我帮他收集这些东西……黑色羽毛的事，或许魔法密林的精灵们知道些什么。

英文正文: Go see Maya in Henesys.
中文正文: 去射手村见见玛雅吧。

英文正文: I got a request from Maya of Henesys, who likes collecting all kinds of items. She wants 20 of each of the following: Orange Mushroom Cap, Green Mushroom Cap, Blue Mushroom Cap, and Horny Mushroom Cap. It looks like I can get all of these from hunting monsters around the prairie...
中文正文: 射手村的玛雅喜欢收集各种各样的东西，这次她向我提出了请求。她要橙蘑菇伞盖、绿蘑菇伞盖、蓝蘑菇伞盖和角蘑菇伞盖各20个。这些应该都能在草原一带狩猎怪物时拿到……

英文正文: This time Maya wants 20 of each of the following: Pig's Ribbon, Bubbling's Huge Bubble, Fire Boar's Tooth, and Tablecloth. I can get those from hunting monsters around the plateau, subway station, and prairie... Well, at least it'll be easy!
中文正文: 这次玛雅要猪的蝴蝶结、泡泡鱼的大泡泡、火野猪的牙齿和桌布各20个。这些东西可以在高原、地铁站和草原一带狩猎怪物获得……至少这次还算轻松！

英文正文: Maya requested 30 of each of the following: Iron Hog's Metal Hoof, Lupin Doll, Cold Eye Tail, and Tortie Shell. I can get those from monsters in the highland, beach, and prairie. A little more of a challenge...
中文正文: 玛雅这次要铁猪的金属蹄、鲁平娃娃、冷眼的尾巴和乌龟壳各30个。这些可以在高地、海滩和草原的怪物身上拿到。稍微有点难度了……

英文正文: Go see Maya in Henesys.
中文正文: 去射手村见见玛雅吧。

英文正文: Maya asked me to gather 1 Diamond, 50 Stone Golem Rubble, and 50 Dark Stone Golem Rubble. I can get them by defeating monsters at the Golem's Temple, which is on the way from Henesys to the dungeon... but this is getting way too hard!
中文正文: 玛雅让我收集1颗钻石、50块石头人的碎石和50块黑石头人的碎石。这些可以去石头人神殿打倒怪物获得，那里就在射手村通往地下城的路上……可这越来越难了吧！

中文正文: 去射手村找皮娅吧。

This time, she wants to make a claw as a present for a friend in Ellinia, who's embarking on an adventure soon. The claw she wants to make requires 15 Silver Ingots, 30 Dragon Skins, and 30 Screws... If I get her all these... will I be richly rewarded?
中文正文: 我又在射手村公园遇到了那个穿着泰迪熊人偶服的皮娅。上次见面时，我替她教训了那些蓝蘑菇。这次她想做一只爪子，送给魔法密林一位即将踏上冒险之旅的朋友。要做成这只爪子，需要15块银锭、20张龙皮和30个螺丝……要是我把材料都凑齐了……能得到丰厚的回报吗？

英文正文: Let's go to Pia in Henesys.
中文正文: 去射手村找皮娅吧。

英文正文: Pia also asked me to retrieve the Red Cape that Rina in Henesys borrowed, to give it to her friend too. She'll give me something nice if I bring it back to her.
中文正文: 皮娅还拜托我去取回射手村的丽娜借走的红披风，好一并送给她朋友。只要把披风带回去，她就会给我不错的报酬。

英文正文: It seems Rina has her own reasons for not returning Pia's cape.
中文正文: 看来丽娜不归还皮娅的披风，是有她自己的苦衷。

英文正文: I went to see Rina in Henesys, and she told me she actually took that red cape because Pia also hasn't returned some items that she borrowed. She says that she'll return the cape when she gets her things back... The items are 1 Black Crystal, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 30 Medicine With Weird Vibes.
中文正文: 我去射手村找了丽娜，她说自己扣下那件红披风，是因为皮娅也一直没有归还向她借的东西。她说等拿回自己的东西，就把披风还回去……那些东西是1个黑水晶、1个古代卷轴和30瓶怪味药。

英文正文: It looks like Rina is ready to return the Red Cape she borrowed from Pia.
中文正文: 看来丽娜已经愿意归还从皮娅那里借走的红披风了。

英文正文: I finally got my hands on the Red Cape that Pia asked for. Now, I just need to bring it back to her.
中文正文: 我终于拿到了皮娅要的红披风。接下来只要把它带回去交给皮娅就行。

中文正文: 我在射手村见到了布鲁斯，他带来了天大的好消息——他终于找到女儿了！！可问题也随之而来……她失忆了！布鲁斯把女儿从小喜欢的玩具交给我，让我送去给她。

# 英文标题: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
中文阶段标题: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
英文正文: Amazingly, Ayan recovered from her amnesia with the help of her toy sword. It was amazing! The only thing left now is for Ayan and Bruce to finally reunite. But first, I have to get this letter from Ayan back to Bruce.
中文正文: 真难以置信，阿燕借着那把玩具剑恢复了记忆，太神奇了！现在只差让阿燕和布鲁斯父女团聚。不过在那之前，我得先把阿燕的这封信送到布鲁斯手上。

英文正文: Arwen the Fairy from Ellinia told me that she lost Arwen's Glass Shoe a couple of days ago, on her way to Perion. A monster covered in flames stole it! Fairies tend to obsess over glimmering, shiny objects, so she obviously wants it back... Time to go hunt some boars near Perion.
中文正文: 魔法密林的妖精阿雯告诉我，她几天前在去勇士部落的路上弄丢了阿雯的玻璃鞋。是被一只浑身是火的怪物抢走的！妖精天生迷恋闪闪发亮的东西，她当然想把它找回来……该去勇士部落附近打野猪了。

英文正文: I think Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia has something to ask me...
中文正文: 魔法密林的妖精罗雯似乎有事要拜托我……

英文正文: I ran into Rowen the Fairy again, who had given me Fresh Milk for Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son, last time. Back then, she seemed guarded, but now, she's accepted me as Ronnie's friend... Rowen the Fairy is an assistant for the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old. She's concerned about the Cursed Dolls: evil dolls he'd made with black magic, a long, long time ago. While they'd been sealed for quite some time, a bunch of Lupins recently stole them and got away. The Lupins have since become zombies and are destroying the forest. To take back the forest, someone needs to eliminate the Zombie Lupins and take the Cursed Dolls away from them... So, I readily accepted the request to collect 50 Cursed Dolls, but I fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...
中文正文: 我又遇到了妖精罗雯，上次她托我把鲜奶带给韦特巴顿先生的儿子罗尼。那时她还很戒备，如今已经把我当成罗尼的朋友了……妖精罗雯是魔法密林首席魔法师格雷的助手。她一直挂念着诅咒娃娃——那是很久很久以前，格雷用黑魔法造出的邪恶娃娃。它们被封印了很长时间，最近却被一群路平偷走并逃了出去。那些路平后来变成了僵尸，正在毁掉森林。要夺回森林，就得消灭僵尸路平，从它们手里收回诅咒娃娃……于是我爽快地接下了收集50个诅咒娃娃的委托，只是担心那群疯猴子不好对付……

英文正文: 70? Well, that shouldn't be too hard...
中文正文: 70个？嗯，应该不算太难……

中文正文: 妖精罗雯又找我帮忙了，这次要打倒100只僵尸路平，收集100个诅咒娃娃。事情变得越来越严重了……

英文正文: Rowen the Fairy asked for my help again, this time to hunt 150 Zombie Lupins and collect 150 Cursed Dolls. Now that's a lot of Cursed Dolls!
中文正文: 妖精罗雯又找我帮忙了，这次要打倒150只僵尸路平，收集150个诅咒娃娃。这数量可真不少！

英文正文: Rowen the Fairy asked for my help one last time, this time to hunt 200 Zombie Lupins and collect 200 Cursed Dolls. Does she really need THIS many? Is it working?
中文正文: 妖精罗雯最后一次找我帮忙，这次要打倒200只僵尸路平，收集200个诅咒娃娃。她真的需要这么多吗？这办法有用吗？

# 英文标题: I Need Help on My Homework!
英文正文: Wing the Fairy of Ellinia seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I'd expect from someone asking for a FAVOR. Well, he asked me to get him 10 Leafs, 10 Squishy Liquids, and 3 Slime Bubbles. They're ingredients for a potion he was assigned to make for homework.
中文正文: 魔法密林的妖精温似乎一向看不起人类，这态度可不像是在求人帮忙。不过他还是拜托我弄来10片树叶、10份软软的液体和3个史莱姆泡泡，说是他做作业要配的药水材料。

英文正文: It looks like Shane in Ellinia is looking for an adventurer to lend a hand.
中文正文: 魔法密林的肖恩好像在找冒险家帮忙。

英文正文: Shane in Ellinia wants to eat a delicious mushroom dish and asked me to find some ingredients for him. He said that Green Mushroom Caps are a favorite of his, so I should head out and hunt Green Mushrooms near the forest.
中文正文: 魔法密林的肖恩想吃一道美味的蘑菇料理，托我去找些食材。他说绿蘑菇伞是他的最爱，那我该去森林附近打绿蘑菇了。

# 英文标题: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More
中文阶段标题: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More
英文正文: It looks like Shane in Ellinia has another favor to ask.
中文正文: 魔法密林的肖恩似乎还有事要拜托我。

# 英文标题: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More
中文阶段标题: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More
英文正文: Shane in Ellinia said he learned of an even better way to cook Green Mushroom Caps and asked me to bring some Green Mushroom Caps, as well as a Lemon.
中文正文: 魔法密林的肖恩说他学会了更好的绿蘑菇伞做法，让我带些绿蘑菇伞和一个柠檬给他。

英文正文: There is a runaway kid named Alex in Kerning City...
中文正文: 废弃都市有个离家出走的少年，名叫亚历克斯……

英文正文: On a lonely building rooftop in Kerning City, I met a boy named Alex, who's run away from home because of a fight with his father, Chief Stan, in Henesys. But Alex is exhausted from being on the run and is out of money. He wants to go home and try to work things out with his strict, but admittedly loving, father. He asked me if I could persuade his father to not punish him for what he did. Also, he wants me to bring the Old Gold Watch his mother left him when she died, as proof that he really did have his father's forgiveness.
中文正文: 在废弃都市一栋冷清的楼顶上，我遇到了名叫亚历克斯的少年。他因为和射手村的父亲斯坦村长吵架而离家出走，如今已经跑得精疲力尽，钱也花光了。他想回家，和那位虽然严厉、却确实疼爱他的父亲好好谈谈。他问我能不能说服父亲不再追究他的错，还让我把他母亲去世时留给他的旧金表带回来，作为父亲真的原谅了他的凭证。

英文正文: At the entrance of Henesys, I met Alex's father, Chief Stan, the chief of Henesys. He wouldn't let me even start a conversation about Alex with him, and he demanded I bring him 15 Green Mushroom Caps and 15 Blue Mushroom Caps if I want to talk to him.
中文正文: 在射手村入口，我见到了亚历克斯的父亲——射手村村长斯坦。他连提都不许我提亚历克斯，还说想跟他说话，就先拿15个绿蘑菇伞和15个蓝蘑菇伞来。

英文正文: At the entrance of Henesys, I met Alex's father Chief Stan, the chief of Henesys. He was even more ornery and difficult to talk to than I'd anticipated, but I finally convinced him to accept Alex back home with open arms. I also got Alex's late mother's Old Gold Watch as proof. Now, all I need to do is deliver this watch to Alex in Kerning City.
中文正文: 在射手村入口，我见到了亚历克斯的父亲——射手村村长斯坦。他比我想象的还要固执难缠，但我最终还是说服了他，让他愿意敞开怀抱接亚历克斯回家。我也拿到了亚历克斯亡母的旧金表作为凭证。现在只要把这块表送到废弃都市的亚历克斯手上就行了。

英文正文: I hear that Nella at Kerning City is the one to talk to if I'm looking for work...
中文正文: 听说想找活干，就该去废弃都市找内拉……

英文正文: I paid Nella a commission of 1,000 mesos in exchange for her bringing me various jobs and requests from the citizens of Kerning City. The first request is from Don Hwang, the owner of the armor shop, who needs materials for crafting new armor. I need to defeat 20 Orange Mushrooms and 20 Ribbon Pigs, and collect 10 Orange Mushroom Caps and 10 Pig's Ribbons. It shouldn't be too hard, since Orange Mushrooms and Ribbon Pigs are easy to find near Kerning City.
中文正文: 我付给内拉1,000金币作为酬劳，请她把废弃都市居民的各种工作和委托介绍给我。第一个委托来自防具店老板唐黄，他需要制作新防具的材料。我得打倒20只橙色蘑菇和20只蝴蝶猪，收集10个橙色蘑菇伞和10条蝴蝶结。橙色蘑菇和蝴蝶猪在废弃都市附近很常见，应该不难。

英文正文: I got a second request from Nella. Shumi, who usually hangs out in front of the subway, wants to build a house for the puppy she just got from a friend. I need to defeat 25 Dark Stumps and bring 15 Leafs to Nella for the dog house.
中文正文: 我从内拉那里接到了第二个委托。常在地铁口闲逛的舒米想给朋友刚送她的小狗搭个窝，我得打倒25个黑树桩，再把15片树叶交给内拉，用来做狗窝。

英文正文: I got a third request from Nella. Andre, an assistant at the Kerning City Hair Salon, is a lifelong bachelor and is apparently struggling with improving his cooking skills. He wants to try his hand at making some tasty seafood soup. I'll need to defeat 30 Octopus and collect 20 Octopus Legs, and also get 1 Pure Water. Once I've gathered everything, I need to deliver them to Nella.
中文正文: 我从内拉那里接到了第三个委托。废弃都市理发店的助手安德烈一直单身，据说正为提升厨艺发愁。他想试着做一锅鲜美的海鲜汤，我得打倒30只章鱼，收集20条章鱼腿，还要弄到1瓶纯净水。东西凑齐后，交给内拉就行。

英文正文: Nella thinks I've grown a lot since my last visit; she's going to start giving me tasks of a slightly higher difficulty from here on out. First, she told me that Dr. Faymus, the owner of Kerning City Pharmacy, was working on a new potion when he ran out of ingredients. He needs me to hunt 40 Jr. Neckis and 40 Horny Mushrooms, and collect 20 Jr. Necki Skins and 20 Horny Mushroom Caps. Taking on Jr. Neckis could be a bit tricky, but for me, it shouldn't be too much trouble!
中文正文: 内拉觉得我比上次来时长进不少，从今往后会给我难度稍高一些的任务。她说废弃都市药店的老板法伊姆斯医生在研制新药水时材料用完了。医生要我打倒40只小尼斯和40只花蘑菇，收集20张小尼斯的皮和20个花蘑菇伞。对付小尼斯可能有点棘手，不过对我来说应该不算什么！

英文正文: I got another request from Nella. Chris's pillow was stolen a few days ago, and now he just can't get to sleep. To make a new pillow, he needs 20 Stiff Feathers and 20 pieces of Leather. I should get them as soon as possible, so Chris can get some sleep!
中文正文: 内拉又给我带来一个委托。克里斯的枕头几天前被偷了，他现在怎么也睡不着。要做新枕头，他需要20根硬羽毛和20块皮革。我得尽快弄到，好让克里斯睡个好觉！

英文正文: I got another request from Nella. Cutthroat Manny, the owner of the weapon shop, is quite the unusual foodie--he wants to cook up a special dish of Evil Eye Tail Stew. He needs me to hunt 50 Evil Eyes and bring back 30 Evil Eye Tails. Sounds like he'll be eating well for a while! Once I've gotten everything, I should bring it all back to Nella.
中文正文: 内拉又给我带来一个委托。武器店老板冷血曼尼是个口味特别的美食家，他想做一道特别的炖菜——邪恶之眼尾巴炖锅。他要我打倒50只邪恶之眼，带回30条邪恶之眼的尾巴。看来他有一阵子能吃得不错了！东西凑齐后，我得全部交给内拉。

英文正文: I hear someone's been seen inside the Niora Hospital in Kerning City...
中文正文: 听说有人在废弃都市的尼奥拉医院里看到过一个陌生人……

英文正文: I met Jane Doe inside the Niora Hospital in Kerning City. Jane Doe needs to take off her bandages to see the results of her surgery, but there's no mirror in the nearly abandoned building. Jane Doe asked me to defeat 40 Stirges and collect 20 Broken Mirror Glasss, so she could take a look at herself...
中文正文: 我在废弃都市的诺拉医院里遇到了简·多伊。她想拆下绷带看看手术的效果，可这栋几乎被废弃的楼里连一面镜子都没有。简·多伊请我去击败40只吸血蝙蝠，再收集20块破碎的镜片，好让她能看看自己的样子……

英文正文: The stranger I met in the Niora Hospital was, surprisingly, a ghost! She's been in the hospital all this time--unaware that she'd died, waiting for Dr. Niora to return... Now, unwilling to accept her death, she needs me to defeat 50 Zombie Mushrooms and collect 25 Charm of the Undead to bring her back to life. I really wonder if that's all it takes...
中文正文: 我在诺拉医院遇到的那个陌生人竟然是幽灵！她一直待在医院里，浑然不知自己早已死去，还在等着诺拉医生回来……如今她仍不肯接受自己的死，要我去击败50只僵尸蘑菇、收集25个亡灵符咒，好让她复活。我真怀疑这些东西是否真能办到……

英文正文: It seems that Lakelis in Kerning City is looking for a party to take on a party quest that requires multiple adventurers to work together.
中文正文: 废弃都市的拉凯莉丝似乎在寻找一支队伍，去挑战需要多名冒险者协力完成的组队任务。

英文正文: Lakelis in Kerning City asked me to challenge the party quest First Time Together and defeat King Slime inside. The party quest must be attempted by a party of four adventurers, all level 21 or higher. Once all members are ready, the party leader can speak to Lakelis to start the party quest. Better start looking for some friends to join me.
中文正文: 废弃都市的拉凯莉丝让我去挑战组队任务初次同行，击败里面的史莱姆王。该组队任务必须由4名21级以上的冒险者组队挑战，等所有队员准备完毕，队长才能与拉凯莉丝对话开启。看来我得先找几个同伴了。

英文正文: Let's start looking for Shumi in Kerning City.
中文正文: 先去废弃都市找舒米吧。

英文正文: I met this girl named Shumi in Kerning City. She's devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she asked me to find it for her. She told me a bunch of guys draped in white cloths picked it up when she dropped it, and that I might find them at Construction Site B1, deep in the subway station... I guess I should head there first...
中文正文: 我在废弃都市遇到了一个叫舒米的女孩。她弄丢了向朋友借来的幸运硬币，难过得不行，拜托我帮她找回来。她说硬币掉在地上时，被几个浑身裹着白布的家伙捡走了，那些人可能就在地铁深处的建设工地B1。我想我得先去那里看看……

# 英文标题: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash
英文正文: Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.
中文正文: 去废弃都市找舒米吧。

# 英文标题: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash
英文正文: I ran into Shumi again in Kerning City. She was really stressed out because she lost her rent money when a Stirge flew over and snatched it from her. Man... Do I have to go back down to the subway again...? Can I just pay her rent for her at this point? Anyway, I need to go back in there, this time to Construction Site B2, and find the roll of cash she lost. Aye, better get going...
中文正文: 我又在废弃都市碰到了舒米。她正为弄丢房租钱而焦头烂额——一只吸血蝙蝠飞过来，把钱从她手里抢走了。天啊……我又得下地铁了吗……干脆我替她把房租交了算了？不管怎样，我还得再下去一趟，这次是去建设工地B2，找回她丢的那卷钞票。唉，还是赶紧出发吧……

# 英文标题: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash
英文正文: I got Shumi from Kerning City the lost roll of cash. Guess she can pay her rent now... and as a reward, she gave me 30 Blue Potions... She also said I can find other items at Construction Site B2... I should go check it out sometime...
中文正文: 我从废弃都市的舒米那儿帮她找回了丢失的钞票。这下她总算能交房租了……作为谢礼，她给了我30瓶蓝色药水……她还说在建设工地B2能找到别的道具……有机会我也该去看看……

# 英文标题: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash
中文阶段标题: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash
英文正文: Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.
中文正文: 去废弃都市找舒米吧。

# 英文标题: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash
中文阶段标题: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash
英文正文: I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. A while ago, she was doing a favor for JM From tha Streetz and getting some Screws for him. But the Sack of Cash he gave her to buy them fell out of her pocket while she was walking around in the subway, and she lost it. She said it fell deep into the subway station, to Construction Site B3.
中文正文: 我又在废弃都市遇到了舒米。不久前，她替街头JM跑腿，去弄一些螺丝钉。可他给她买螺丝钉的那袋钱，在她经过地铁时从口袋里掉了出来，就这么弄丢了。她说钱袋一路滚进了地铁深处，落到了建设工地B3。

英文正文: I should go see Icarus, who's at the top of a building in Kerning City. He seems to be bored out of his mind.
中文正文: 我该去废弃都市见见伊卡洛斯，他就在一栋大楼的顶上。他看上去无聊到了极点。

英文正文: I went to talk to Icarus in Kerning City. What exactly was he doing, staring aimlessly at the sky? He seemed really bored and asked me if I'd answer his questions.
中文正文: 我去废弃都市找伊卡洛斯说话。他到底在干什么，就那么呆呆地望着天空？他看起来实在无聊，问我愿不愿意回答他几个问题。

英文正文: I answered all of Icarus's questions. But he still seemed bored out of his mind; he asked me if I'd bring him a toy to play with.
中文正文: 我回答了伊卡洛斯的全部问题。可他看上去还是无聊得要命，又问我能不能给他带个玩具来玩。

英文正文: Apparently, there's someone in Kerning City by the name of Icarus that stands on top of a building just staring at the sky, 24/7.
中文正文: 听说废弃都市有个叫伊卡洛斯的家伙，整天站在大楼顶上望着天空，一天到晚都是如此。

英文正文: I went to meet Icarus on top of a building in Kerning City. He was a nice guy with an unquenchable thirst for flying. He's trying to fulfill his lifelong dream of flying by building a hang glider. He asked if I'd gather up the materials for it, and I couldn't reject his sincere desire to fly, even though this whole endeavor seems dubious at best. I'll need to get him 30 Stirge Wings, 10 Processed Woods, and 15 Stiff Feathers.
中文正文: 我在废弃都市的一栋大楼顶上见到了伊卡洛斯。他人不错，对飞行有着压不住的渴望。他正靠造一架滑翔翼来实现毕生的飞行梦，问我能不能帮他凑齐材料。虽然这事怎么看都不靠谱，可他这份真诚的愿望我实在没法拒绝。我需要给他30个吸血蝙蝠翅膀、10个加工木材和15根硬羽毛。

英文正文: I wonder how Icarus's doing with the hang glider... Maybe I should go check up on him in Kerning City.
中文正文: 不知道伊卡洛斯的滑翔翼做得怎么样了……也许我该去废弃都市看看他。

英文正文: Icarus failed to build a working hang glider, and, persistent in his never-ending quest for flight, is now attempting to create a flying balloon. This seems just as preposterous as his last idea, but I don't think I can stop him, so I might as well help him. To make the flying balloon, he needs 50 Tablecloths and 10 Alligator Skin Pouches. For his sake, I really hope this works...
中文正文: 伊卡洛斯的滑翔翼没能做成，可他追逐飞行的念头始终没断，这回又打算造一个热气球。这主意听着和上一个一样离谱，但我想我劝不住他，索性帮他一把。要造热气球，他需要50块桌布和10个鳄鱼皮袋。看在他的份上，我真希望这次能成……

# 英文标题: In search of Wing the Fairy
英文正文: I wonder how Icarus's doing with the flying balloon... Maybe I should go check up on him in Kerning City.
中文正文: 不知道伊卡洛斯的飞行气球做得怎么样了……也许我该去废弃都市看看他。

# 英文标题: In search of Wing the Fairy
英文正文: Icarus's flying balloon didn't work out, but his quest for flight continues. This time, he wants to deviate from a scientific approach and opt for a magical one. He asked me to go see his best friend, Wing the Fairy, in Ellinia, the town of fairies. Apparently, Wing the Fairy knows how to make Flying Medicine... I'll need to go see him in Ellinia, for Icarus's sake.
中文正文: 伊卡洛斯的飞行气球又失败了，但他对飞行的追求还在继续。这一次，他想抛开科学的路子，改走魔法。他让我去魔法密林找他的好朋友妖精温，据说妖精温懂得制作飞行药水……为了伊卡洛斯，我得去魔法密林一趟。

# 英文标题: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine
中文阶段标题: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine
英文正文: It doesn't seem easy to talk to Wing the Fairy.
中文正文: 看来和妖精温说话并不容易。

# 英文标题: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine
中文阶段标题: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine
英文正文: I met Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, and he REALLY doesn't seem to like people. As a whole. How did he and Icarus become best friends in the first place? Anyway, in order to make the Flying Medicine, he needs 50 Medicine With Weird Vibes and 20 Witchgrass Leafs. That's really all it takes to fly?
中文正文: 我在魔法密林见到了妖精温，他看上去真的很讨厌人类，讨厌所有人。他和伊卡洛斯到底是怎么成为好朋友的？总之，要制作飞行药水，他需要50瓶散发怪异气息的药水和20片巫草叶。就凭这些真能飞起来吗？

英文正文: It looks like the Flying Medicine that will finally fulfill Icarus's dream is finally ready.
中文正文: 看来能让伊卡洛斯如愿以偿的飞行药水终于做好了。

英文正文: Wing the Fairy of Ellinia asked me to deliver the Flying Medicine to Icarus. So this little bottle can make someone fly? I need to get this to Icarus ASAP.
中文正文: 魔法密林的妖精温让我把飞行药水送去给伊卡洛斯。这么一小瓶东西就能让人飞起来？我得尽快把它送到伊卡洛斯手上。

英文正文: I hear that Blackbull in Perion is fixing up his house.
中文正文: 听说勇士部落的黑牛正在修房子。

英文正文: In the dusty town of Perion, I ran into a man named Blackbull. He needs to fix his house and asked if I could help him out by defeating 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps and getting him 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs. If I do him a favor, I'll get a nice shield from him, but what if I say no? I won't be... BANISHED from the village... will I? I really hope not...
中文正文: 在尘土飞扬的勇士部落，我遇到了一个叫黑牛的人。他要修房子，问我能不能帮他击败20个树桩和20个黑树桩，再弄来10根树枝和10片树叶。要是帮了他，他会送我一面上好的盾牌；可要是我拒绝呢？我总不至于被赶出村子吧……？但愿不会……

英文正文: I got Blackbull of Perion 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs after defeating 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward... and... well, there are scratch marks here and there, and it looks pretty old... Is this even usable?
中文正文: 我替勇士部落的黑牛击败了20个树桩和20个黑树桩，拿到了10根树枝和10片树叶。有了这些，他终于能修好房子了。作为报酬，我得到了这面盾牌……呃……上面到处是划痕，看着挺旧的……这东西还能用吗？

# 英文标题: Building a New House For Blackbull
中文阶段标题: Building a New House For Blackbull
英文正文: I hear that Blackbull in Perion is building a new house...
中文正文: 听说勇士部落的黑牛正在盖新房子……

# 英文标题: Building a New House For Blackbull
中文阶段标题: Building a New House For Blackbull
英文正文: I ran into Blackbull again, the guy whose house I'd helped fix before. He was surprised at how strong I'd gotten and asked me for another favor, a bit harder than the last one. His cousins from Henesys are trying to move to Perion, so he needs to build a new house for them! The materials he needs for this project are 100 Stone Golem Rubbles, 30 Screws, 30 Processed Wood, and Blackbull's Deed to the Land. His son had the deed when it was stolen by Curse Eyes near Sleepywood... Hmmm... I should look for ones wandering around in the Deep Forest...
中文正文: 我又遇到了黑牛，就是之前我帮他修过房子的那个人。他惊讶于我的实力长进，又拜托我一件事，比上次难一些。他射手村的亲戚打算搬到勇士部落来，所以他得给他们盖一间新房子！这项工程需要的材料是100块石头人碎片、30个螺丝钉、30个加工木材，还有黑牛的地契。地契本来在他儿子手上，却在林中之城附近被诅咒之眼抢走了……嗯……我该去森林深处找那些游荡的家伙。

英文正文: Find Manji in Perion.
中文正文: 去勇士部落找曼吉。

英文正文: I visited Manji again, whom I'd first met in Perion, when making the medicine for Maya of Henesys. Surprised at how much stronger I've become, Manji asked me for a favor. Long ago, when he was in danger of being struck down by Balrog, he was saved by the legendary hero Tristan, who ended up dying in Manji's place. Ever since then, Manji has held onto Tristan's sword. However, the blade was so corrupted by Balrog that it's almost too worn down to even be called a sword anymore... Manji handed me the Old Gladius that he'd held onto all these years and asked me to reawaken its true form. Once fully awakened, it will become the Hero's Gladius. Manji told me to begin with seeking out Chrishrama in Sleepywood.
中文正文: 我又去拜访了曼吉——当初为射手村的玛雅配药时，我在勇士部落第一次见到他。曼吉惊讶于我的成长，也拜托了我一件事。很久以前，他险些被巴洛古击倒，是传说中的英雄特里斯坦救了他，特里斯坦也因此替他而死。从那以后，曼吉一直保存着特里斯坦的剑。可那把剑被巴洛古侵蚀得太厉害，几乎已经称不上是剑了……曼吉把这些年珍藏的旧短剑交给我，请我唤醒它真正的形态。完全觉醒之后，它将成为英雄短剑。曼吉让我先去林中之城找克里斯玛。

英文正文: See Chrishrama in Sleepywood to awaken the Old Gladius.
中文正文: 去林中之城找克里斯玛，唤醒旧短剑。

英文正文: I showed Chrishrama Manji's Old Gladius, and he revealed that he was the sword's creator. He needs 1 Star Rock, 1 Piece of Ice, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 1 Flaming Feather to awaken it. Unfortunately, I've never heard of any of those items... He recommended talking to Mike in Perion Dungeon Entrance to get started.
中文正文: 我把曼吉的旧短剑拿给克里斯玛看，他坦言自己正是这把剑的铸造者。要唤醒它，他需要1块星石、1块冰、1卷古代卷轴和1根火焰羽毛。可惜这些东西我一样都没听说过……他建议我先去勇士部落地下城入口找迈克打听。

英文正文: After much hardship, I finally managed to gather all the materials Chrishrama asked for. Now, I can only trust in his power.
中文正文: 历经千辛万苦，我终于凑齐了克里斯玛所要的全部材料。现在，我只能相信他的本事了。

英文正文: With Chrishrama's help, I awakened the Old Gladius, entrusted to me by Manji, into the Hero's Gladius. All that remains now is to return the sword to Manji.
中文正文: 在克里斯玛的帮助下，我把曼吉托付的旧短剑唤醒成了英雄短剑。剩下要做的，就是把剑还给曼吉。

英文正文: I hear that Winston the archeologist is searching for something in the Rocky Mountains on the east side of Perion...
中文正文: 听说考古学家温斯顿正在勇士部落东边的岩石山里寻找什么东西……

英文正文: Winston, an archaeologist I ran into in the Rocky Mountains east of Perion, has lost the fossils he's meticulously been collecting in the region. He asked me to bring back 12 Animal Fossils and 12 Plant Fossils, which have been stolen by Green Mushrooms and Axe Stumps. How could he lose such important things? He's more careless than he looks...
中文正文: 我在勇士部落以东的岩石山遇到了考古学家温斯顿，他在这片地区辛苦收集的化石全丢了。他让我带回12块动物化石和12块植物化石，那些东西被绿蘑菇和斧头树桩抢走了。这么重要的东西怎么能弄丢呢？他比看上去还要粗心……

英文正文: It seems the archaeologist Winston in the Rocky Mountains, east of Perion, has another request.
中文正文: 勇士部落东边岩石山的考古学家温斯顿似乎又有事相求。

英文正文: Winston the archaeologist has realized that it's not the best idea to leave such valuable fossils in a tent. He asked me to deliver them to Dr. Betty in Ellinia for safekeeping. He also wrote me a letter of introduction to show her.
中文正文: 考古学家温斯顿意识到，把这么珍贵的化石留在帐篷里可不是好主意。他让我把化石送到魔法密林的贝蒂博士那里妥善保管，还写了一封介绍信让我带上。

英文正文: Dr. Betty, a biologist near Ellinia, is looking for an assistant.
中文正文: 魔法密林附近的生物学家贝蒂博士正在找助手。

英文正文: Dr. Betty asked me to help out as her assistant for a bit. My first task is to collect 8 Plant Samples. I can see a lot of plants covering the woods in Ellinia.
中文正文: 贝蒂博士请我暂时代理她的助手。第一项任务是收集8份植物样本。魔法密林的森林里到处都是植物，随处都能看到。

英文正文: It seems the biologist, Dr. Betty, in Ellinia has another request.
中文正文: 魔法密林的生物学家贝蒂博士似乎又有事相求。

英文正文: Dr. Betty in Ellinia needs 1 Stuffed Drake Skull for her research. She asked me to fetch one from her daughter, who should be near Henesys. But where exactly would Anne be...?
中文正文: 魔法密林的贝蒂博士需要1个飞龙头骨标本用于研究。她让我去找她的女儿拿，人应该在射手村附近。可安妮究竟会在哪儿呢……？

英文正文: It looks like Anne has the item that Dr. Betty needs.
中文正文: 看来贝蒂博士需要的东西就在安妮手上。

英文正文: I got the Stuffed Drake Skull from Anne, Dr. Betty's daughter. Now, to deliver this VERY CAREFULLY to Dr. Betty...
中文正文: 我从贝蒂博士的女儿安妮那里拿到了飞龙头骨标本。接下来，得把它非常小心地送到贝蒂博士手上……

英文正文: I hear Dr. Betty has finished her fossil research. Maybe I should go and see the results.
中文正文: 听说贝蒂博士的化石研究已经完成了。也许我该去看看结果。

英文正文: I visited Dr. Betty again. She finally completed her research and asked if I could take the final report to Dr. Winston in Perion. Dr. Betty also informed me that if I were to take 20 Leafs, 15 pieces of Firewood, 1 Stump's Teardrop, and 1 pair of Weighted Earrings, it'd make Dr. Winston very happy.
中文正文: 我再次拜访了贝蒂博士。她的研究终于完成，还问我能不能把最终报告送到勇士部落的温斯顿博士手中。贝蒂博士还告诉我，如果能顺带带上 20 个树叶、15 块木柴、1 个木墩的眼泪和 1 副加重耳环，温斯顿博士一定会非常高兴。

英文正文: Ayan of Perion says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...
中文正文: 勇士部落的阿扬说她一步也不敢踏出城外。不知道是为什么……

英文正文: I met Ayan in Perion. She can't remember anything about her childhood and lives every day in fear of the Stumps that surround Perion. She finds even looking at them too scary. Due to this paralyzing fear of Stumps, Ayan can't take a single step out of Perion, so she asked me to help her by thinning their numbers. Are they really THAT scary?
中文正文: 我在勇士部落见到了阿扬。她完全不记得童年的事，每天都活在木墩的恐惧里，连看它们一眼都害怕。因为这种令她动弹不得的恐惧，阿扬一步也走不出勇士部落，于是拜托我帮她削减木墩的数量。它们真有那么可怕吗？

英文正文: I hear something happened to the tribespeople of Perion. I should go ask Ayan about this.
中文正文: 听说勇士部落的族人出了事。我该去问问阿扬。

英文正文: I spoke with Ayan in Perion. A few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp and wound up being ambushed by a group of Ligators. She's worried about the sudden surge of Ligators, and other alligator monsters, taking over the swamp and asked me to reduce their numbers before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis and pick up 20 Jr. Necki Skins along the way.
中文正文: 我和勇士部落的阿扬谈过了。几天前，一群族人去沼泽狩猎，却遭到一群鳄鱼的伏击。她担心鳄鱼和其他鳄鱼系怪物突然增多、占据整片沼泽，便请我在它们失控繁殖之前削减数量。我得杀死 100 只鳄鱼和 40 只小尼克，途中还要收集 20 张小尼克的皮。

英文正文: Ayan of Perion is desperately looking for me. Is something wrong?
中文正文: 勇士部落的阿扬正急着找我。出什么事了吗？

英文正文: I went to see Ayan, and she was in a panic. She had been walking around the swamp one day, when she ran into an even bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators, Crocos. She immediately turned and ran back to Perion. She'd been waiting for me to come by since then, hoping I could help her. This time, I'll need to kill 120 Crocos and bring back 50 Croco Skins.
中文正文: 我去见了阿扬，她惊慌得不知所措。那天她在沼泽里走着，撞上了一群更大、更强、也更危险的鳄鱼——鳄鱼王。她立刻转身逃回了勇士部落，之后一直等着我过来，希望我能帮她。这次我得杀死 120 只鳄鱼王，并带回 50 张鳄鱼王的皮。

# 英文标题: A Clue to the Secret Book
中文阶段标题: A Clue to the Secret Book
英文正文: I hear Mr. Wetbottom in Sleepywood is going through hard times... I should go check on him.
中文正文: 听说林中之城的韦特巴顿先生最近过得很不顺……我该去看看他。

# 英文标题: A Clue to the Secret Book
中文阶段标题: A Clue to the Secret Book
英文正文: I met an old, balding man named Mr. Wetbottom in the VIP Sauna in Sleepywood. His son's run away from home with a book that's apparently more important to him than his own son?? He asked that I find his son, get the book, and bring JUST the book back. He offered me a nice sauna robe as a reward. Mr. Wetbottom told me that his son, Ronnie, likes to hang out at a tree tunnel somewhere around Ellinia. That's probably a good place to start searching. Seriously, though, just what is in this book of his...???
中文正文: 我在林中之城的贵宾桑拿房见到了一位秃顶的老人，韦特巴顿先生。他的儿子带着一本书离家出走了——那本书似乎比自己的儿子还重要？他要我找到他儿子，拿回那本书，而且只要书。作为报酬，他答应送我一件不错的桑拿浴袍。韦特巴顿先生还说，他儿子罗尼喜欢待在魔法密林一带的树洞隧道里。那里大概是开始寻找的好地方。不过说真的，那本书里到底写了什么……？？？

# 英文标题: A Clue to the Secret Book
中文阶段标题: A Clue to the Secret Book
英文正文: I found Ronnie in the tree tunnel of Ellinia, as requested by Mr. Wetbottom, whom I met at the VIP Sauna.
中文正文: 按照在贵宾桑拿房遇到的韦特巴顿先生的请求，我在魔法密林的树洞隧道里找到了罗尼。

英文正文: Rina of Henesys needs 50 Curse Eye Tails and 10 Pig's Heads as ingredients to make her unagi special.
中文正文: 射手村的莉娜需要 50 条诅咒之眼的尾巴和 10 个猪头作食材，用来制作她的特制鳗鱼。

英文正文: I brought everything Rina asked for, and she whipped up a plate of Rina's Unagi Special for me. I hope Ronnie will finally be satisfied with this...
中文正文: 我把莉娜要的东西全都带来了，她当场为我做了一盘莉娜特制鳗鱼。希望罗尼这次能满意……

英文正文: Rowen the Fairy of Ellinia asked for a beautiful, glittering Diamond in exchange for a glass of Fresh Milk. A Diamond... And just how exactly am I supposed to get such a rare, expensive item?
中文正文: 魔法密林的妖精罗温说，只要我拿一颗美丽闪亮的钻石来换，就给我一杯鲜奶。钻石……这种又稀有又昂贵的东西，我到底该上哪儿弄啊？

英文正文: I brought Rowen the Fairy a Diamond in exchange for a glass of Fresh Milk. I hope Ronnie will FINALLY be satisfied with this...
中文正文: 我拿一颗钻石向妖精罗温换了一杯鲜奶。希望罗尼这次总该满意了……

英文正文: I got Ronnie all kinds of yummy snacks and finally got his dad's Secret Book in exchange. I really want to take just one peek...
中文正文: 我给罗尼弄来了各种各样的美味零食，终于换到了他父亲的秘密之书。真想偷偷看上一眼……

# 英文标题: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
中文阶段标题: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
英文正文: Let's go look for Sabitrama in Sleepywood.
中文正文: 去林中之城找萨比特拉玛吧。

# 英文标题: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
中文阶段标题: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
英文正文: I met Sabitrama, a medicinal herb trader, in front of the Sleepywood Hotel. He appears to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He recently discovered a place that grows the last herb he needs for a medicine he's been working on... He asked me to go deep in the forest and grab the Pink Anthurium. It's made of green grass and a small pink flower... I need to make sure I get him the same exact one. Shane from Ellinia can take me to the right place.
中文正文: 我在林中之城旅馆门前见到了药草商人萨比特拉玛。他似乎是克莉丝拉玛的弟弟。他最近发现了一个地方，那里长着他研制药物所需的最后一味草药……他让我深入森林，采回粉色红掌。那是一种由绿草和小粉花组成的植物……我必须采到一模一样的那一株。魔法密林的谢恩能把我送到正确的地方。

英文正文: I hear that Sabitrama in Sleepywood is making a new medicine...
中文正文: 听说林中之城的萨比特拉玛正在研制新药……

英文正文: I ran into Sabitrama in front of the Sleepywood Hotel again, the one I helped get herbs for before. This time, he found a new place with a different important herb that he needs for another type of medicine he's working on. He asked me to go back to the forest and grab a Double-Rooted Red Ginseng for him. It has a reddish root split in two... I should make sure I grab the same exact one once I get to the top. I guess that means I have to go back to Shane in Ellinia...
中文正文: 我又在林中之城旅馆门前遇到了萨比特拉玛，就是之前帮他采药的那位。这次他发现了一个新地方，那里长着另一种重要草药，是他研制另一种药所需要的。他让我再回森林，为他采回双根红参。那是一种根部分成两叉、泛着红色的参……到了顶端，我一定得采到一模一样的那一株。看来我还得再去找魔法密林的谢恩……

英文正文: The cave fairy Zelya of the Forgotten Hollow seems to have a request. But even finding where the Forgotten Hollow is located may be a challenge in itself...
中文正文: 遗忘洞穴的洞穴妖精泽莉亚似乎有事相求。可光是找到遗忘洞穴的位置，恐怕就已经是个难题……

英文正文: Zelya, a cave fairy in the Forgotten Hollow, told me about how her people once lived deep, deep inside the cave. She longs to return to her old home, but she was attacked by Glowshrooms while out on a walk and dropped the map she'd drawn to find her way back. The monsters may have already torn it to pieces, but if I defeat the Glowshrooms, east of Forgotten Hollow, and gather the fragments, she might be able to figure something out.
中文正文: 遗忘洞穴的洞穴妖精泽莉亚告诉我，她的族人曾住在洞穴很深很深的地方。她渴望回到故乡，可有次外出散步时遭到发光蘑菇袭击，把自己画好的返乡地图弄丢了。地图也许已被怪物撕成碎片，但只要我去遗忘洞穴东边打败发光蘑菇、把碎片收集起来，她或许能想出办法。

英文正文: The cave fairy Zelya in the Forgotten Hollow seems to have a new request.
中文正文: 遗忘洞穴的洞穴妖精泽莉亚似乎又有了新的请求。

英文正文: Zelya, a cave fairy in the Forgotten Hollow, has been struggling with piecing together the fragments of her map. She asked me to bring her Raffle Petals from Raffles east of the village to help in restoring it. Looks like that's where I'm headed, then!
中文正文: 遗忘洞穴的洞穴妖精泽莉亚一直在为拼合地图碎片而苦恼。她让我去村子东边打拉夫尔，带回拉夫尔花瓣，好帮她修复地图。看来这趟是免不了了！

英文正文: The cave fairy Zelya in Forgotten Hollow seems to have yet another request.
中文正文: 遗忘洞穴的洞穴妖精泽莉亚似乎还有一件事要拜托我。

英文正文: Zelya managed to restore her precious map and tried to follow it back to her old home, but she couldn't make it past the fierce monsters blocking the way. She asked me to defeat the monsters west of the Forgotten Hollow to help her get home safely.
中文正文: 泽莉亚终于修好了那张珍贵的地图，想照着它回故乡，却被拦路的凶猛怪物挡住了去路。她请我去打败遗忘洞穴西边的怪物，好让她平安回家。

英文正文: As Zelya requested, I defeated Aqumanders and Echopuses. Yet it felt as though monsters continued to pour out from deeper within the cave. What on earth could be happening inside?
中文正文: 我按泽莉亚的请求打败了阿库曼德和回声章鱼。可洞穴深处似乎仍有怪物不断涌出。里面到底发生了什么？

英文正文: Myra in Perilous Descent I seems to be overcome with grief.
中文正文: 险峻坡道 I 的米拉似乎沉浸在悲伤之中。

英文正文: Myra in Perilous Descent I wants her changed companions to rest in peace. She asked me to put to rest the nearby Myewoods, as well as the Sporewoods deeper in the cave.
中文正文: 险峻坡道 I 的米拉希望那些变了模样的同伴能够安息。她让我去让附近的米伍德，以及洞穴深处的孢子木安息。

英文正文: Myra in Perilous Descent I seems to have another request.
中文正文: 险峻坡道 I 的米拉似乎还有别的请求。

英文正文: Myra in Perilous Descent I asked me to tell her old friend, Grendel the Really Old, what had happened in the Forgotten Hollow. I should be able to find Grendel the Really Old atop Ellinia, in the Magic Library.
中文正文: 险峻坡道 I 的米拉让我去把遗忘洞穴发生的事告诉她的一位老朋友——老葛雷登。他应该在魔法密林山上的魔法图书馆里。

英文正文: Let's go see Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia. He seems deeply troubled by something...
中文正文: 去魔法密林见老葛雷登吧。他似乎正为某件事深深烦恼……

英文正文: Grendel the Really Old, whom I met in Ellinia, asked me to gather 25 Luminous Magical Resonance vials from the Lupins. I should go to the forest and retrieve them so he can pinpoint the source of the magical disturbance.
中文正文: 我在魔法密林见到的老葛雷登让我从路平身上收集 25 瓶发光的魔法共鸣液。我该去森林里把它们取回来，好让他查明魔法异动的源头。

# 英文标题: Special Taste of Florina Beach I
中文阶段标题: Special Taste of Florina Beach I
英文正文: A beautiful girl by the name of Riel from Florina Beach seems to be in need of help...
中文正文: 弗洛里纳海滩有一位叫莉尔的美丽女孩，似乎正需要帮助……

# 英文标题: Special Taste of Florina Beach I
中文阶段标题: Special Taste of Florina Beach I
英文正文: Riel introduced me to a part time job, where I have to collect 10 Coconuts. Why don't I start collecting those delicious looking Coconuts over there on the right?
中文正文: 莉尔给我介绍了一份兼职，要收集 10 个椰子。不如就从右边那些看起来很好吃的椰子开始收集吧？

# 英文标题: Special Taste of Florina Beach II
中文阶段标题: Special Taste of Florina Beach II
英文正文: Riel in Florina Beach asks me a question about Florina Beach. Piece of cake. I can answer that before I start my work.
中文正文: 弗洛里纳海滩的莉尔问了我一个关于弗洛里纳海滩的问题。小菜一碟，开工前我就能答上来。

中文正文: 杰伊在书房里找到一本破烂的冒险日志，却完全看不懂。中间的书页已经不见了，但最后一页上仍写着：b"每位英雄都会留下印记，但只有追随线索的人才能找到它。"n 这样的一句话，只有藏着一笔值得藏的宝藏时才写得出来。去找杰伊谈谈吧。

英文正文: The first page of the Adventurer's Journal reads: b"Where the sea meets a shore guarded by little snouts."n Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
中文正文: 冒险家日志的第一页写着：b"大海与海岸相接之处，有小小的鼻子在守望。"n 只有 10 级以上的角色才能完成此任务。

英文正文: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 2 reads: b"I spent one night beneath a stranger's roof."n Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
中文正文: 冒险家日志第 2 页写着：b"我在陌生人的屋檐下度过了一夜。"n 只有 10 级以上的角色才能完成此任务。

英文正文: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 3 reads: b"The forest remembers what the traveler forgets."n Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
中文正文: 冒险家日志第 3 页写着：b"森林记得旅人遗忘的一切。"n 只有 10 级以上的角色才能完成此任务。

英文正文: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 4 reads: b"Where shadows gather, leave no coin unturned."n Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
中文正文: 冒险家日志第 4 页写着：b"阴影聚集之处，一枚硬币也别放过。"n 只有 10 级以上的角色才能完成此任务。

英文正文: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 5 reads: b"Beyond the familiar path, the wild ones roam."n Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
中文正文: 冒险家日志第 5 页写着：b"熟悉的道路之外，野兽们四处游荡。"n 只有 10 级以上的角色才能完成此任务。

英文正文: The Adventurer's Journal - Page 6 reads: b"Beneath the earth, even the smallest footsteps may lead the way."n Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
中文正文: 冒险家日志第 6 页写着：b"在地底，哪怕最微小的脚步也可能指引方向。"n 只有 10 级以上的角色才能完成此任务。

英文正文: Past the hidden portal, at the end of Ant Tunnel Park, the trail finally ran out — and the bMark of the Betan was lying there waiting. b"Every hero leaves a mark. But only those who follow the trail will find it."n So that is what the log meant. The mark is mine now, and the next one is mine to leave.
中文正文: 穿过隐藏的传送口，在蚂蚁洞公园的尽头，线索终于断了——而 b贝塔的印记就在那里等着我。b"每位英雄都会留下印记，但只有追随线索的人才能找到它。"n 原来日志说的就是这个。如今这枚印记属于我，而下一枚，该由我来留下。

英文正文: Myen in Forgotten Hollow looks like he hasn't slept. Something of his has gone missing. Someone has been stealing Myen's ward scrolls. A man named Alston buys fairy-made goods. He keeps to a hidden rooftop above the internet cafe in Kerning City. I found Alston, a fence who buys goods from the Hollow. He won't say who sells to him.
中文正文: 遗忘空洞的米恩看起来一夜没睡。他丢了东西。 有人在偷米恩的守护卷轴。一个叫奥尔斯顿的人专门收购妖精制作的货物，他藏在废弃都市网吧上方一处隐蔽的天台。 我找到了奥尔斯顿，这个收赃的专门买空洞的货。他不肯说谁卖给他的。

英文正文: Alston won't give out names for free. Alston's runner lost his ledger in the Hollow, and Golden Stirges grabbed the pages. If I bring back 20 Alston's Ledger Pages from Primeval Forest II and Forgotten Entrance I, he will tell me who sells him fairy goods. I brought Alston his ledger pages. He told me his best supplier is a young thief named Whitney.
中文正文: 奥尔斯顿不会白给名字。 奥尔斯顿的手下把账本丢在了空洞里，账本页被黄金蝙蝠抢走了。只要我从原始森林 II 和遗忘入口 I 带回 20 张奥尔斯顿的账本页，他就告诉我谁卖妖精货物给他。 我把账本页带给了奥尔斯顿。他说他最好的供货商是个叫惠特妮的年轻盗贼。

英文正文: Alston gave me his supplier's name. Alston's best supplier is a young thief named Whitney. She hides on a hidden rooftop above the Hair Salon in Kerning City. I found Whitney on the rooftop. She admitted she has been taking things from the Hollow.
中文正文: 奥尔斯顿告诉了我他供货商的名字。 奥尔斯顿最好的供货商是个叫惠特妮的年轻盗贼。她藏在废弃都市美发厅上方一处隐蔽的天台。 我在天台上找到了惠特妮。她承认一直在从空洞里拿东西。

英文正文: Whitney is ready to explain why she steals from the Hollow. Whitney's partner Perry is sick. His skin is turning purple, and there's no one to treat him. It looks like the rot from the Hollow. I should ask Daniel the Scholar in Precipice of Darkness. I told Daniel the Scholar about Perry. He believes it is the rot, but there may still be time.
中文正文: 惠特妮愿意解释她为什么从空洞里偷东西。 惠特妮的伙伴佩里病了。他的皮肤正在变成紫色，却没有人能治他。看起来像是空洞的腐烂。我该去问问黑暗峭壁的学者丹尼尔。 我把佩里的事告诉了学者丹尼尔。他认为那就是腐烂，但也许还来得及。

英文正文: Daniel the Scholar knows a way to slow the rot. Some Rotten Mushrooms still carry caps the rot never reached. Daniel the Scholar told me how to brew them into a remedy that slows the rot. I need to collect 25 Untainted Mushroom Caps in Precipice of Darkness and bring them to Whitney on a hidden rooftop above the Hair Salon in Kerning City. I brought the caps to Whitney. They won't cure Perry, but they'll buy him time.
中文正文: 学者丹尼尔知道一种延缓腐烂的办法。 有些腐烂蘑菇身上还留着腐烂从未触及的伞盖。学者丹尼尔告诉了我怎么把它们熬成一种延缓腐烂的药。我需要去黑暗峭壁收集 25 个纯净蘑菇伞盖，再送到废弃都市美发店上方一处隐蔽的屋顶，交给惠特妮。 我把伞盖交给了惠特妮。它们治不好佩里，但能为他争取时间。

英文正文: Whitney has something else to tell me. Whitney overheard the Dark Lord's men planning a raid on the Hollow. I should confront the Dark Lord in the Thieves' Hideout. The Dark Lord admitted his men plan to raid the Hollow. He also told me who tipped him off: Alston.
中文正文: 惠特妮还有别的事要告诉我。 惠特妮无意中听到达克鲁的手下计划突袭空洞。我应该去盗贼藏身处与达克鲁对峙。 达克鲁承认他的手下计划突袭空洞。他还告诉我是谁给他通风报信的：奥尔斯顿。

英文正文: The Dark Lord has an offer for Alston. Alston told the Dark Lord about the Hollow. The Dark Lord will call off the raid if the fairies agree to trade, but he needs someone to speak for the guild. I should give Alston the offer on a hidden rooftop above the internet cafe in Kerning City. Alston admitted he sold out the Hollow. He agreed to speak for the guild, but he needs Whitney's help to stop the raid.
中文正文: 达克鲁给奥尔斯顿开出了条件。 奥尔斯顿把空洞的事告诉了达克鲁。如果妖精们同意交易，达克鲁就会取消突袭，但他需要有人替家族说话。我应该去废弃都市网吧上方的隐蔽屋顶，把这个提议交给奥尔斯顿。 奥尔斯顿承认他出卖了空洞。他同意替家族说话，但他需要惠特妮的帮助来阻止突袭。

英文正文: Alston needs Whitney's help. The guild's messengers need Whitney's secret route into the Hollow, but it isn't safe. I need to defeat 60 Raffles in Forgotten Entrance II and Forgotten Entrance III, then talk to Whitney. I cleared the route, and Whitney agreed to let the guild use it. She admitted she still has Myen's scrolls and tongs.
中文正文: 奥尔斯顿需要惠特妮的帮助。 家族的信使需要惠特妮通往空洞的秘密路线，但那并不安全。我需要在遗忘入口 II 和遗忘入口 III 击败60只莱芙，然后和惠特妮谈谈。 我清出了路线，惠特妮同意让家族使用它。她承认米恩的卷轴和钳子还在她那里。

英文正文: Whitney is ready to send the guild's offer to the fairies. I need to bring the Dark Lord's offer and Myen's Ward Scrolls to Myen in Forgotten Hollow. Myen got his scrolls back and accepted the truce for the Hollow. Alston will speak for the guild, and Whitney and her friends will keep watch over the route into the Hollow.
中文正文: 惠特妮准备把家族的提议送给妖精们。 我需要把达克鲁的提议和米恩的守护卷轴带给遗忘空洞的米恩。 米恩拿回了他的卷轴，并为空洞接受了这次停战。奥尔斯顿将替家族说话，惠特妮和她的朋友们会看守进入空洞的路线。

英文正文: A small firefly in Rotten House seems to need help. Glimmer lives alone in an old house next to Someone Else's Grave. Rotten Mushrooms from the grave keep pushing their rot in under her door. She asked me to defeat 60 Rotten Mushrooms. I defeated the Rotten Mushrooms outside Glimmer's house. For now, the door is safe.
中文正文: 腐烂之屋里的一只小萤火虫似乎需要帮助。 微光独自住在别人的坟墓旁一栋老房子里。坟墓里的腐烂蘑菇不断把腐烂从她门缝下推进来。她请我击败 60 只腐烂蘑菇。 我击败了微光家门外的腐烂蘑菇。眼下，这扇门是安全的。

英文正文: Glimmer has another favor to ask. Every Zombie Mushroom at Someone Else's Grave carries a Charm of the Undead full of rot. Glimmer thinks her light can burn the rot out of them. She asked me to bring her 50 Charm of the Undead. I brought Glimmer the Charm of the Undead. Her light burned the rot out of them, but she senses something deeper under Someone Else's Grave still feeding it.
中文正文: 微光还有一件事要拜托我。 别人的坟墓那里的每只僵尸蘑菇都带着一枚充满腐烂的道符。微光觉得她的光能把腐烂从里面烧掉。她请我带给她 50 枚道符。 我把道符带给了微光。她的光把里面的腐烂烧掉了，但她感觉到别人的坟墓更深处还有什么东西仍在滋养着腐烂。

英文正文: Glimmer is afraid of what the rot is doing to her house. Glimmer is afraid her light is too weak to hold back the rot, and the Rotten Mushmom near Someone Else's Grave keeps coming closer. Myen in Forgotten Hollow makes glowspore wards. I should bring him 30 Giant Tree's Boughs from the Myewoods so he can make one. I brought Myen the materials. He started on a glowspore ward for Glimmer's door.
中文正文: 微光害怕腐烂正在对她的房子做的事。 微光担心自己的光太弱，挡不住腐烂，而别人的坟墓附近的腐烂蘑菇王又越来越近。遗忘空洞的米恩会制作荧光孢子护符。我该从木喵带 30 根巨树枝给他，好让他做一个。 我把材料带给了米恩。他开始为微光的门制作荧光孢子护符。

英文正文: Myen has finished the ward. Myen made a Glowspore Ward for Glimmer's door. I should bring it to her house at Rotten House. I gave Glimmer the ward. Her house is protected, and she can finally rest her light.
中文正文: 米恩做好护符了。 米恩为微光的门做好了一枚荧光孢子护符。我该把它送到她位于腐烂之屋的家。 我把护符交给了微光。她的房子受到了保护，她终于可以让自己的光歇一歇了。

英文正文: Glimmer is worried about the Rotten Mushmom. The Rotten Mushmom at the back of Someone Else's Grave is the biggest thing the rot has taken. Glimmer wants it gone so her house can rest. I should defeat it and bring its Rotten Mushmom Cap back as proof. I defeated the Rotten Mushmom and showed Glimmer its Rotten Mushmom Cap. The house is quiet again.
中文正文: 微光担心腐烂蘑菇王。 别人的坟墓深处的那只腐烂蘑菇王，是腐烂夺走的最大之物。微光希望它消失，好让她的房子安宁。我该去击败它，并带回它的腐烂蘑菇王帽作为证据。 我击败了腐烂蘑菇王，把它的腐烂蘑菇王帽给微光看。房子又安静下来了。

英文正文: I heard Winston is looking for ways to liven up the barren grounds of Perion. Thanks to the excavation project, Perion and its surrounding areas have been rapidly deteriorating. To liven up the area, Winston wanted me to get him Seedlings to plant around the area. Get Winston 50 Seedlings from Ghost Stumps at Excavation Sites. I defeated Ghost Stump and collected Seedling. Winston promised to liven up the currently-barren Perion by planting lots of trees around the area, and he'll be the first to start it.
中文正文: 我听说芳博士正在想办法让勇士部落贫瘠的土地恢复生机。 由于发掘工程，勇士部落及其周边地区正在迅速荒芜。为了让这片地区恢复生机，芳博士希望我能给他弄些苗木种在周围。从遗迹发掘地的古木妖身上收集50个苗木交给芳博士。 我击败古木妖，收集了苗木。芳博士答应会在这一带种下许多树，让如今荒芜的勇士部落重新焕发生机，而他会第一个开始动手。

英文正文: Winston, who resides at the East Rocky Mountain II, said Shawn the excavator asked him for a favor... Lately, the excavation site has been hit with an unknown monster. As a result, Winston requested that I study the reason behind the monster's creation. To conduct the research, I'll have to collect 20 each of Wooden Board and Slate that Wooden Mask and Rocky Mask use. He said studying Wooden Board and Slate will take some time. I better wait til it gets done with.
中文正文: 住在东部岩山Ⅱ的芳博士说，挖掘工杉峰有事相求…… 最近，挖掘现场遭到了一只不明怪物的袭击。因此，芳博士希望我调查这只怪物诞生的原因。为了进行研究，我得收集木面怪人和石面怪人使用的木板和石板各20个。 他说研究木板和石板需要一些时间。我还是等研究结束吧。

英文正文: Winston asked me to wait while he's analyzing Wooden Board and Slate. Winston seemed shocked to find out what he had found out through studying Wooden Board and Slate, but he didn't want to divulge the information on me. He wanted me to first eliminate the monsters, so I'll do that. Winston claimed the monsters have decreased dramatically, but I disagree. Not only that, but I felt a strange vibe around the excavation site. What would that be...
中文正文: 芳博士让我等他分析完木板和石板。 芳博士似乎对自己通过研究木板和石板得出的结论感到震惊，但他不愿把这件事告诉我。他想让我先消灭怪物，那我就照做吧。 芳博士声称怪物已经大幅减少，但我并不同意。不仅如此，我还在遗迹发掘地周围感到了一种奇怪的气息。那到底是什么……

英文正文: Someone's telling me there's an urgent notice posted on the bulletin board at the excavation camp. I read a notice posted on the bulletin board at Excavation Site <Camp>. It said that many members of the excavation team had been injured by a skeleton army that appeared in the Tomb of the Ruins, and asked for someone to defeat Skeledog x100 and Mummydog x100, then bring Skeledog's Bone x60 and Dirty Bandage x60 to Shawn as proof. I defeated the skeletons in the Tomb of the Ruins, collected their bones and bandages, and brought them to Shawn, a member of the excavation team.
中文正文: 有人告诉我，挖掘营地的公告板上贴了紧急通知。 我读了遗迹发掘队营地的公告板上贴出的通知。上面说，许多挖掘队成员被遗迹之墓中出现的骷髅军团所伤，希望有人击败骷髅犬100只和木乃伊犬100只，然后把骷髅犬的骨头60个和绷带60个交给杉峰作为证明。 我击败了遗迹之墓中的骷髅，收集了它们的骨头和绷带，交给了挖掘队成员杉峰。

英文正文: Manji in Perion looks troubled. Maybe I should talk to him. Manji said the mushrooms in the Ant Tunnel have the same dark smell as the Balrog he fought long ago. He asked me to defeat 30 Horny Mushrooms and 30 Zombie Mushrooms, then come back and tell him what I saw. I defeated the mushrooms in the Ant Tunnel. Manji said the dark power under Victoria Island is waking up again, and that I should keep getting stronger.
中文正文: 佩里昂的麦吉看起来很烦恼。也许我该和他谈谈。 麦吉说，蚂蚁洞里的蘑菇身上，有着和他很久以前交过手的巴洛古一样的黑暗气味。他让我击败30只刺蘑菇和30只僵尸蘑菇，然后回去告诉他我看到了什么。 我击败了蚂蚁洞里的蘑菇。麦吉说，金银岛地下的黑暗力量又苏醒过来了，我应当继续变强。

英文正文: Blackbull in Perion has a story about the first people of Perion. Blackbull says the first settlers of Perion came up through the Ant Tunnel. The deepest part of their road is now The Tunnel That Lost Light I, full of Cold Eyes. I need to defeat 40 Cold Eyes. I defeated the Cold Eyes on the old settlers' road. Blackbull was glad the road his grandfather walked is safer again.
中文正文: 酋长有一则关于勇士部落最初居民的故事。 酋长说，勇士部落最初的定居者是从蚂蚁洞走上来的。他们那条路最深的地方如今是冰独眼兽洞穴Ⅰ，到处是冰独眼兽。我需要击败40只冰独眼兽。 我击败了古老定居者之路上的冰独眼兽。酋长很高兴他祖父走过的那条路又安全了。

英文正文: Manji in Perion wants to tell me something about the deep Ant Tunnel. Manji told me about the hero Tristan, who saved his life and fell deep in the Ant Tunnel while fighting the Balrog. Now Drakes nest in that place. I need to defeat 200 Drakes. I defeated the Drakes in the deep Ant Tunnel. Manji thanked me and asked me to remember Tristan, the way he does.
中文正文: 佩里昂的麦吉有话要告诉我，是关于蚂蚁洞深处的。 麦吉给我讲了英雄特里斯坦的事。那位英雄救过他的命，在与巴洛古战斗时倒在了蚂蚁洞深处。如今青龙在那里筑了巢。我需要击败200只青龙。 我击败了蚂蚁洞深处的青龙。麦吉向我道谢，并让我像他一样记住特里斯坦。

英文正文: Manji in Perion has news from the deep Ant Tunnel. Manji says Wild Kargos now crowd the tunnel past Another Entrance, on the old path toward the place where the Balrog sleeps. I need to defeat 100 Wild Kargos and bring him 40 Wild Kargo Eyes. I defeated the Wild Kargos past Another Entrance and brought Manji their eyes. He will keep them by his fire. If they start to glow, he will know the Balrog is waking.
中文正文: 佩里昂的麦吉带来了蚂蚁洞深处的消息。 麦吉说，如今另外的入口之后的通道里挤满了怪猫，那是一条通往巴洛古沉睡之地的旧路。我需要击败100只怪猫，并给他带回40个怪猫的眼。 我击败了另外的入口之后的怪猫，把它们的眼睛带给了麦吉。他会把眼睛放在火边。如果眼睛开始发光，他就知道巴洛古要醒了。

英文正文: Manji in Perion is calling for me. Something has changed. The Wild Kargo Eyes by Manji's fire are glowing. He says the Balrog's guards are gathering at the Sanctuary Entrance. I need to defeat 30 Tauromaciss and 30 Taurospears. I defeated the guards at the Sanctuary Entrance. Manji says the way to The Cursed Sanctuary is open.
中文正文: 佩里昂的麦吉在叫我。情况有变。 麦吉火边的怪猫的眼正在发光。他说巴洛古的守卫正在寺院通道聚集。我需要击败30只月牙牛魔王和30只长枪牛魔王。 我击败了寺院通道的守卫。麦吉说，通往被诅咒的寺院的路已经打开了。

英文正文: Manji has one last thing to ask of me. Manji says a Jr. Balrog now holds The Cursed Sanctuary, the place where Tristan made his last stand. I need to defeat the Jr. Balrog. I defeated the Jr. Balrog. But the eyes by Manji's fire didn't go dark. They burned brighter. Manji says it was only the guard at the door.
中文正文: 麦吉还有最后一件事要托付给我。 麦吉说，如今一只蝙蝠怪占据着被诅咒的寺院，那里正是特里斯坦最后奋战的地方。我需要击败蝙蝠怪。 我击败了蝙蝠怪。可麦吉火边的眼睛并没有黯淡下去，反而烧得更亮了。麦吉说，那只是守在门口的守卫罢了。

英文正文: Sabitrama in Sleepywood has a new worry. Sabitrama says the old Mushmom buried in The Grave of Mushmom has risen again as a Zombie Mushmom. Every mushroom near her goes bad, so he can't gather them for medicine. I need to defeat the Zombie Mushmom. I defeated the Zombie Mushmom. Now she can rest again, and Sabitrama can gather his mushrooms.
中文正文: 林中之城的萨比特拉玛有了新的担忧。 萨比特拉玛说，葬在蘑菇王之墓的蘑菇王又复活成了僵尸蘑菇王。她附近的蘑菇都会腐烂，所以他采不到做药的蘑菇。我需要击败僵尸蘑菇王。 我击败了僵尸蘑菇王。现在她又能安息了，萨比特拉玛也能采他的蘑菇了。

英文正文: Hotel Receptionist at the Sleepywood Hotel looks like nobody at the hotel has slept in days. Hotel Receptionist says something taps on the windows of the Sleepywood Hotel every night, and the guests hear a voice say their names. Hotel Receptionist hopes it's only the Stirges from the Ant Tunnel. I need to defeat 30 Stirges in Dark Cave and Dangerous Steam, and bring back 30 Stirge Wings for a chime. I defeated the Stirges and brought back their wings. The tapping stopped, and the guests slept. But the guest in Room 3 still won't open his door.
中文正文: 林中之城旅馆的宾馆服务员看起来像旅馆里已经好几天没人睡过觉了。 宾馆服务员说，每天夜里都有东西敲林中之城旅馆的窗户，客人们听见有声音叫他们的名字。宾馆服务员希望那只是蚂蚁洞里的蝙蝠。我需要去黑暗通道和蝙蝠洞击败30只蝙蝠，并带回30只蝙蝠翅膀做风铃。 我击败了蝙蝠，带回了它们的翅膀。敲窗声停了，客人们睡着了。但3号房的客人还是不肯开门。

英文正文: Hotel Receptionist at the Sleepywood Hotel hung a chime by the door. Something about it isn't right. Hotel Receptionist hung a chime of Stirge wings by the door. It rings all night, even though there is no wind in Sleepywood. I need to ask Sabitrama about it. Sabitrama says the air under Sleepywood has started to move, like something breathing. The guests say they sleep better. I'm not so sure.
中文正文: 林中之城旅馆的宾馆服务员在门边挂了一只风铃。它有点不对劲。 宾馆服务员在门边挂了一只蝙蝠翅膀做的风铃。它整夜都在响，可林中之城里根本没有风。我需要去问问萨比特拉玛。 萨比特拉玛说林中之城下面的空气开始流动了，像有什么东西在呼吸。客人们说他们睡得更好了。我可没那么确定。

英文正文: Sabitrama in Sleepywood looks pale. Something is wrong with the water. Sabitrama says the hot spring under Sleepywood went cold, and now everyone who drinks its water dreams of faces. The spring comes from The Tunnel That Lost Light I, full of Cold Eyes. I need to defeat 50 Cold Eyes and bring him 30 Cold Eye Tails. I defeated the Cold Eyes and gave Sabitrama their tails. Something drank their warmth. And for one moment, the spring felt warm, like something breathed on it from below.
中文正文: 林中之城的萨比特拉玛脸色苍白。水出了问题。 萨比特拉玛说林中之城下面的温泉变冷了，现在每个喝了温泉水的人都会梦见人脸。泉水来自冰独眼兽洞穴Ⅰ，那里满是冰独眼兽。我需要击败50只冰独眼兽，并给他带回30条冰独眼兽之尾。 我击败了冰独眼兽，把它们的尾巴给了萨比特拉玛。有什么东西吸走了它们的温暖。有那么一刻，泉水变暖了，像是有什么东西从下面朝它呼了口气。

英文正文: Sabitrama in Sleepywood has a warning that must reach Perion. Sabitrama thinks the hunger under Sleepywood is the same darkness Manji felt long ago. I need to take his warning to Manji in Perion. I told Manji what Sabitrama found. He said whatever is down there doesn't wake up all at once. It drinks the warmth first.
中文正文: 林中之城的萨比特拉玛有一个警告，必须送到佩里昂。 萨比特拉玛认为，林中之城地下的那种饥饿，就是麦吉很久以前感受到的同一股黑暗。我需要把他的警告带给佩里昂的麦吉。 我把萨比特拉玛的发现告诉了麦吉。他说，那下面的东西不会一次全部醒来。它会先喝掉温暖。

英文正文: A note on the Worn Notice Board in Ant Tunnel Park asks for help. A note from the 24 Hr Mobile Store on the Worn Notice Board in Ant Tunnel Park says Evil Eyes keep scaring away customers with their stares. I need to defeat 30 Evil Eyes. I defeated the Evil Eyes and took the pay pinned to the Worn Notice Board. Now customers can shop in Ant Tunnel Park in peace... at least for a while.
中文正文: 蚂蚁广场的破旧告示板上有一张求助的纸条。 蚂蚁广场的破旧告示板上，一张来自 24小时移动商店 的纸条说，火独眼兽总用目光把顾客吓跑。我需要击败 30 只火独眼兽。 我击败了火独眼兽，取走了钉在破旧告示板上的报酬。现在顾客们可以在蚂蚁广场安心购物了……至少能安生一阵子。

英文正文: There are old notes pinned to the Worn Notice Board in Ant Tunnel Park. A note from a group called the Lantern Party says they went deep into the Ant Tunnel to find a giant mushroom. To follow their trail, I need to defeat 30 Horny Mushrooms in the Ant Tunnel. I followed the Lantern Party's trail through the Ant Tunnel. There was a second note on the board.
中文正文: 蚂蚁广场的破旧告示板上钉着几张旧纸条。 一张来自自称灯笼团的组织的纸条说，他们深入蚂蚁洞寻找一株巨大的蘑菇。为了跟上他们的踪迹，我需要在蚂蚁洞里击败 30 只刺蘑菇。 我沿着灯笼团的踪迹穿过了蚂蚁洞。告示板上还有第二张纸条。

英文正文: There is a second note on the Worn Notice Board in Ant Tunnel Park. Brin's note says the charms that Zombie Mushrooms carry glow brighter near the giant mushroom. I need to collect 30 Charm of the Undeads from Zombie Mushrooms and bring them to the Worn Notice Board. I lined up the Charm of the Undeads by the board. The brightest ones came from the deepest part of the tunnel.
中文正文: 蚂蚁广场的破旧告示板上还有第二张便条。 布林的便条上说，僵尸蘑菇携带的道符在巨大蘑菇附近会发出更亮的光。我需要从僵尸蘑菇身上收集30个道符，交给破旧告示板。 我把道符沿着告示板排成一排。最亮的那些来自洞穴最深处。

英文正文: There is one more note on the Worn Notice Board in Ant Tunnel Park. Lisel's note says Evil Eyes took the Lantern Party's lantern in The Cave of Evil Eye I. To finish their trail, I need to defeat 30 Evil Eyes. I read the Lantern Party's last note. They found the giant mushroom, and it was a Mushmom. They all made it out. I pinned my own note under theirs.
中文正文: 蚂蚁广场的破旧告示板上还有一张便条。 莉赛尔的便条上说，火独眼兽在火独眼兽洞穴Ⅰ抢走了灯笼团的灯笼。为了走完他们的踪迹，我需要击败30只火独眼兽。 我读了灯笼团最后的便条。他们找到了巨大蘑菇，原来那就是蘑菇王。他们全都平安出来了。我把自己的便条钉在了他们的下面。

# 英文标题: The Right to Own a Home
中文阶段标题: 拥有家的权利（废弃都市）
英文正文: It seems Roxy of Kerning City Civic Center has an exciting offer for me. Roxy of Kerning City Civic Center said in an excited voice that she had good news, and told me I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find Jack. Jack of Kerning City Civic Center gruffly told me all about houses.
中文正文: 废弃都市市政中心的罗克西好像有个让人兴奋的提议。 废弃都市市政中心的罗克西兴奋地说有好消息：我获得了在这座城市拥有房子的权利。想了解详情，得去找捷克。 废弃都市市政中心的捷克粗声粗气地把房子的事都跟我讲了。

英文正文: It seems Jack of Kerning City Civic Center has something more to say about houses. Jack of Kerning City Civic Center gruffly told me that if I wanted a house, I should go see Scarlett. I should be able to find Scarlett in the center of Kerning City. It seems I can buy a house from Scarlett of Kerning City. I'll have to remember that.
中文正文: 废弃都市市政中心的捷克好像还有关于房子的事要说。 废弃都市市政中心的捷克粗声粗气地说，想要房子就去找斯嘉丽，她在废弃都市中心。 看来可以从废弃都市的斯嘉丽那里买房子，得记住这件事。
